jobs.description:
Endpoint Engineer

We are seeking an experienced Endpoint Engineer to support large-scale endpoint environments across multiple client infrastructures. This role focuses on maintaining endpoint security posture, ensuring patch compliance, and managing device security operations across enterprise device fleets. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience managing thousands of endpoints in complex environments and will work across endpoint management, vulnerability remediation, and security monitoring activities. This position combines technical engineering responsibilities with operational support and client-facing collaboration.

this is a 5 days onsite position

Key Responsibilities

Plan, test, and deploy operating system and application updates across large endpoint fleets using structured deployment strategies such as pilot groups and phased rollouts.
Monitor patch compliance and coordinate maintenance windows, approvals, and remediation timelines.
Troubleshoot patch deployment failures and coordinate rollback or recovery actions when updates introduce system instability or compatibility issues.
Deploy, configure, and maintain endpoint protection platforms including EDR/XDR solutions.
Tune security policies, configure alerting and prevention settings, and investigate suspicious endpoint activity.
Contain or isolate compromised systems when threats are detected.
Threat Detection and Incident Response

Investigate security alerts and abnormal endpoint behaviors including malware, ransomware, and unauthorized activity.
Support incident response activities including investigation, containment, eradication, and recovery.
Document findings and contribute to post-incident remediation and security improvements.
Review endpoint vulnerability findings and prioritize remediation based on severity and risk exposure.
Track remediation progress and ensure endpoint compliance across operating systems and applications.
Support regular vulnerability scanning validation and endpoint security assessments.
Implement endpoint security configurations and baseline standards across enterprise devices.
Support endpoint encryption, firewall policies, privilege controls, and system security settings.
Develop PowerShell scripts and automation to improve patch deployment, compliance reporting, and endpoint management processes.
Generate operational reports and security metrics related to patch status, endpoint coverage, and vulnerability remediation.
Maintain device inventory and asset lifecycle records for enterprise endpoints including desktops, laptops, and associated services.
Ensure endpoints remain compliant with patching and security requirements throughout their lifecycle.
Identify and remove outdated, unauthorized, or unsupported tools and applications from endpoint environments.
Communicate security posture updates, patch compliance status, and incident response activities to internal teams and client stakeholders.
Participate in operational reviews and security discussions to provide technical insights and recommendations.

Qualifications:

Required Qualifications

3+ years of experience supporting endpoint environments within a managed services, service provider, or multi-tenant IT environment.
Hands-on experience with endpoint device management platforms and endpoint administration tools.
Experience operating endpoint detection and response (EDR/XDR) platforms and endpoint vulnerability management solutions, including policy configuration and incident containment.
Working knowledge of PowerShell scripting for automation, reporting, or operational tasks.
Strong understanding of Windows endpoint administration, device compliance in Active Directory or Entra ID, and basic networking concepts.
Experience managing large endpoint environments of 2,000+ devices including desktops and laptops.
Experience overseeing patch management and compliance for enterprise endpoint fleets.
Familiarity with endpoint asset inventory and lifecycle management processes.
Ability to troubleshoot patch failures and implement remediation or rollback strategies when necessary.
Strong communication skills with the ability to provide clear updates during security reviews or operational incidents.
Preferred Experience

Experience supporting hybrid enterprise environments integrating on-prem and cloud-based infrastructure.
Familiarity with endpoint security monitoring, threat investigation, and vulnerability remediation workflows.
Exposure to automation, reporting tools, and endpoint security metrics tracking.
Experience supporting large enterprise or multi-client endpoint environments.

Compensation

$75,000.00-$100,000.00 Yearly

jobs.description:
We are hiring Network/Infrastructure Engineer for a Full Time position in chicago, IL

Network/Infrastructure Engineer

Company Overview
We are a pioneering Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS) company, focusing on delivering High-Performance Computing (HPC) solutions. Our cutting-edge data centers form the core of our operations, empowering us to offer unmatched computational resources to our global clientele. In line with our growth and the expansion of our services, we are looking for a motivated Junior Network/Infrastructure Engineer to join and grow with our team.

Position Summary The Network/Infrastructure Engineer plays a hands-on role in deploying the compute and network infrastructure that powers our high-performance computing environments. This role centers on data center deployment work: installing and configuring Proxmox hypervisors and virtual machines, assisting with BGP router deployments, standing up out-of-band (OOB) management fabrics on Unifi or NVIDIA switching, and helping build RDMA compute fabrics (primarily RoCEv2, with potential InfiniBand exposure). You will work under the guidance of senior engineers and travel to US data center sites to support new deployments, troubleshooting, and bring-up activities. This is an ideal role for someone with homelab and/or internship experience who is eager to learn enterprise-scale infrastructure from the ground up.

Work Arrangement & Location:
Remote with required travel

25-50% travel (nationwide)

Travel lasts 2-3 weeks and is typically every 2-3 months

Please focus on candidates located in one of the following states. Boost is not looking to add employees in additional states at this time.

States of Preference: ME, NH, NJ, GA, FL, IL, MN, WA, TX

Key Responsibilities
Virtualization & Compute Deployment
Install, configure, and maintain Proxmox hypervisors on bare-metal servers during data center deployments
Provision and manage virtual machines, including resource allocation, templates, and standardized deployment profiles
Perform routine patching, upgrades, and lifecycle maintenance of hypervisor hosts and guest VMs
Assist with server imaging, initial configuration, and validation during site bring-up

Network Deployment & Operations
Assist senior engineers with the deployment and initial configuration of BGP routers at new data center sites
Rack, cable, and configure out-of-band (OOB) management fabrics using Unifi or NVIDIA switches
Assist in building and validating RDMA compute fabrics, primarily RoCEv2, with opportunities to gain InfiniBand experience
Perform basic switch and router configuration tasks (VLANs, IP assignments, port configuration) under senior guidance
Help with cable management, labeling, and physical layer troubleshooting during deployments
Learn and apply IP addressing, subnetting, and IPAM documentation practices
Monitor network and infrastructure health using observability tools and escalate issues appropriately
Participate in a supported on-call rotation after an onboarding/ramp-up period

Automation & Tooling
Assist in developing and maintaining automation using Python and/or Ansible for provisioning, configuration, and routine operational tasks
Contribute to infrastructure-as-code playbooks as skills develop
Identify repetitive manual tasks that are candidates for automation

Collaboration & Documentation
Travel to data center locations within the US to support deployments, troubleshooting, and site bring-up (regular travel expected)
Maintain accurate documentation including runbooks, network diagrams, deployment procedures, and configuration records
Work closely with deployment engineers and operations teams during infrastructure builds
Learn from senior engineers through mentorship, pairing, and hands-on deployment work

Safety & Compliance
Adhere to strict data center safety protocols and operational standards during all on-site activities
Follow security best practices for system and network configuration and access control
Participate in regular safety training and briefings

Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field preferred or equivalent hands-on experience, homelab work, or certifications
0 2 years of experience in IT infrastructure, networking, or systems administration; internship and homelab experience strongly valued
Hands-on exposure to virtualization through work, coursework, or personal projects Proxmox experience is a strong plus (KVM, ESXi, or Hyper-V also relevant)
Foundational networking knowledge: IP addressing, subnetting, VLANs, and routing fundamentals; awareness of BGP concepts is a plus
Familiarity with consumer/prosumer or enterprise network gear (Unifi, Cisco, Arista, NVIDIA/Mellanox, etc.)
Interest in high-speed interconnects (RoCEv2, InfiniBand) prior exposure is a bonus
Working knowledge of Linux fundamentals (file systems, services, basic shell commands)
Some scripting or automation experience with Python, Bash, or Ansible strongly preferred
Willingness and ability to travel regularly to US data center locations for deployments
Comfortable with physical deployment work: racking equipment, cabling, and labeling in a data center environment
Strong desire to learn, take direction, and grow into more advanced networking and HPC work
Good troubleshooting instincts and a methodical approach to problem-solving
Solid written and verbal communication skills with attention to documentation
Availability to participate in an on-call rotation after ramp-up

Preferred Certifications
CompTIA Network+, Linux+, or Server+
CCNA or equivalent entry-level networking certification
Red Hat RHCSA or equivalent Linux certification
Any relevant virtualization or cloud fundamentals certification

What We Offer
A vibrant and stimulating work environment with strong mentorship and clear paths for professional growth
A competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package
An inclusive, team-oriented culture that values innovation, efficiency, and collaboration
Hands-on experience deploying cutting-edge HPC infrastructure, including RDMA fabrics and NVIDIA networking
A direct growth path toward senior network and infrastructure engineering roles

Estimated Pay Range: $120-150K

We are certified in ISO 9001:2015, ISO 20000-1:2018, and ISO 27001:2022; CMMC Level 2 certified; and appraised at CMMI Maturity Level 3 for Services and Development.

Job Description

Link Solutions is seeking a Deputy Program Manager/Chief Infrastructure Engineer to support the Army Research Laboratory (ARL) Information Technology Modernization and Support Services program in Adelphi, MD.

Active Secret clearance, or ability to obtain and maintain a Secret ClearanceIAT Level II certification or higher per DoD 8570/8140 requirementsBachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.Non-Remote/On-site only (relocation assistance available)

While the role includes program leadership and modernization responsibilities, successful candidates must possess extensive real-world experience designing, implementing, administering, troubleshooting, and operating large-scale enterprise infrastructure environments.

The ideal candidate is a senior infrastructure engineer who has advanced into technical leadership while maintaining deep expertise across enterprise server platforms, Active Directory, Nutanix infrastructure, enterprise storage, networking, identity services, and datacenter operations.

Candidates whose experience is primarily focused on project management, cybersecurity governance, compliance oversight, or cloud strategy without significant infrastructure engineering experience are unlikely to be successful in this role.

Role OverviewYou will serve as a technical leader responsible for building our core endpoint security agent from the ground up, providing comprehensive visibility and protection across Windows, Linux, and macOS. You will architect a lightweight, highly resilient agent capable of deep OS introspection, autonomous threat prevention, and sophisticated offline telemetry spooling. You will tackle complex challenges in user-mode hooking, kernel-level behavioral analysis, anti-tampering, and distributed systems design to deliver a seamless, high-performance security client.

Required Experience5+ years of experience in systems-level programming and architecting highly concurrent applications

Strong Rust programming skills with a focus on high-performance, low-level OS integrations

Deep understanding of Windows OS internals, including ETW, IPC, Named Pipes, and Windows Services

Experience with cross-platform endpoint telemetry collection utilizing Linux eBPF and macOS ESF

Proven experience in dynamic binary instrumentation, user-mode API interception, and process injection

Experience designing and optimizing low-overhead threat detection heuristics directly on the endpoint

Knowledge of Windows kernel-mode components, specifically designing File Filter Drivers for data-in-motion tracking

Experience architecting resilient distributed systems with offline disk spooling and secure mTLS synchronization

Understanding of offensive and defensive endpoint security concepts, anti-tampering mechanisms, and process protection

Experience building highly reliable agent lifecycles, self-healing architectures, and fail-safe rollback mechanisms

Strong communication and documentation skills

Experience with Microsoft Anti-Malware vendor registration (ELAM, PPL) is a plus

Experience with browser extension development or DOM hooking is a plus

jobs.description:
Position Description & Qualifications

Serco seeks aSimulation Systems and Test Engineerfor its Combat Air Force Distributed Mission Operations (CAF DMO) 3.0 program in Hampton, VA. The CAF DMO 3.0 program, via its Distributed Mission Operations Network (DMON), provides world-class integration training in large force and small team formats to combat units around the globe against cutting-edge threats in a boundless virtual battlespace. The U.S. Air Force can only utilize its full capability against modern threats in a virtual environment. Be a part of that environment and continue to make the USAF the best air force in the world.

You will be part of a focused team of engineers to perform test, integration, and evaluation of disparate M&S systems and applications to support 5th and 6th generation training interoperability.

The team will work closely with the DoD customer and other Serco teams at Langley AFB and Orlando, FL to deliver quality test services.

In this role, you will:
Support simulation system and application integration, evaluation, and interoperability test to support DMON and JSE training operations.Use industry-standard tools for simulation test and evaluation to include Wireshark, simulation protocol analysis, and GFE and Commercial Computer Generated Forces (CGFs).Assist in detailed analysis of network and computational system performance including latency, bandwidth, jitter, and system occupancy measures.Help develop and maintain test plans and procedures to document and drive test activities.Draft comprehensive test reports based on completed integration, test, evaluation, and verification tasks performed.Assist in the development of CONOPS and multiple COAs for implementation and deployment of the evaluated simulation capabilities.Contribute to other areas of the engineering life cycle to include requirements review and assessment, training operations support, and basic system administration functions.Produce well-defined, concise, and directed test procedures and test cases under the guidance of senior engineers.Support program and team processes by using tools from the Atlassian Suite of products to include JIRA, Confluence, Bitbucket, Bamboo, and X-Ray.Participate in peer reviews, test bed maintenance and updates, and programming, testing, and debugging activities.Write and maintain scripts and support application (PowerShell, Cygwin, VBasic, etc.) programs, to enable efficiencies in test artifact creation and task execution.Help identify production and non-production application issues, assist in developing solutions, and implement necessary changes.

To be successful in this role, you will have:
A bachelor's degree in an applicable STEM curriculum (e.g., Data Analysis, System Engineering, Math, Computer Science, Physics, etc.) or similar.8 years of engineering experience performing test, integration, SW development, or embedded systems engineering activities.Secret to Start but the ability to obtain TS/SCI and Secret/SAPExperience supporting DoD customers and personnel in a technical capacity.Familiarity or experience with development, test and evaluation of military training or operational systems.Must possess, or obtain within six months, a DoD 8140 IAT Level II or higher (i.e. Security+, CySA+, CISSP).Up to 10% travel
This position is contingent upon your ability to obtain/maintain/transfer your Secret clearance.

Additional desired experience and skills:
An active DoD Secret Clearance with ability to obtain TS/SCI and SAP/SAR.Familiarity with Military training systems, products, and capabilities.Exposure to or experience in M&S development, test, and integration.Knowledge of or experience with the Joint Simulation Environment (JSE).Possess or obtain within six months, a Linux OS certification (i.e., Linux+, RHCSA etc.).Understanding or familiarity with DIS IEEE1278.1 or HLA IEEE 1516 protocols.

Pay Transparency

Eligible employees also gain access to a wide range of benefits from comprehensive health coverage and health savings accounts to retirement plans, life and disability insurance, and time-off programs that support work-life balance. jobs.description:
Description
We are seeking an Endpoint Management Engineer to design, automate, and operate the enterprise device management platform supporting our global workforce, laboratories, manufacturing sites, and commercial field organization. This role owns hands-on engineering and operations across Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM) in a co-management architecture, with Hybrid Entra ID (Azure AD) joined, Active Directory domain-bound Windows endpoints and a multi-platform Intune estate spanning Windows, macOS, iOS/iPadOS, and Android - including Android-based teleconferencing and conference room systems.
Automation is central to this role. The successful candidate writes production-quality PowerShell, Bash, and .NET code, builds Intune remediation and detection scripts, and uses the Microsoft Graph API to manage the estate programmatically rather than soley through the console. We also expect fluency with modern AI-assisted engineering tools - including Claude or CoPilot - to accelerate script development, log analysis, documentation, and reporting.
Equally important is the discipline required in a regulated pharmaceutical environment. You will advance modern management objectives - Zero Trust, Conditional Access, cloud-first policy delivery, and progressive workload migration from Configuration Manager to Intune - while respecting the reliability requirements of standard corporate devices and the constraints of non-standard, purpose-built systems such as laboratory instrument controllers, manufacturing workstations, kiosks, and validated GxP endpoints. The role partners closely with Information Security, Identity, Networking, Infrastructure, Site IT, and Site Service Support teams.
Key Responsibilities
Automation, Scripting, and Development
Design, write, and maintain production-quality PowerShell for endpoint provisioning, configuration enforcement, bulk administration, reporting, and incident remediation across the Windows estate.
Write and maintain shell/Bash scripts for macOS configuration, compliance validation, and application delivery through Intune macOS shell scripting.
Build and manage Intune Remediations (proactive remediations) - paired detection and remediation script logic - to identify and self-heal configuration drift, failed agents, certificate issues, and compliance gaps without user impact.
Automate platform operations against the Microsoft Graph API, including device and policy inventory, assignment management, application lifecycle tasks, reporting extracts, and integration with adjacent systems.
Apply engineering discipline to automation assets: source control, code review, parameterization, error handling, logging, idempotency, and controlled release through test rings.
Convert recurring manual and Service Desk activities into automated or self-service capabilities.
Core Device Management
Engineer and maintain Intune compliance policies across all platforms, including device health, OS version floors, and custom compliance scripts.
Build and maintain configuration profiles and settings catalog policies, administrative templates, and custom OMA-URI/configuration profiles for Windows, macOS, iOS/iPadOS, and Android.
Familiar with Windows Update for Business and update rings, feature and quality update deployments, driver and firmware update governance, macOS and iOS update policies.
Manage monthly and out-of-band patch operations in Configuration Manager through Software Update Groups, automatic deployment rules, and maintenance windows; drive patch compliance to defined service-level targets and remediate delinquent endpoints.
Package, test, and deploy applications across platforms - Win32 (.intunewin), MSI/MSIX, Microsoft Store, Microsoft 365 Apps, macOS PKG/DMG and shell-script apps, iOS/Android managed apps via volume purchasing - with correct detection rules, dependencies, supersedence, requirement rules, and assignment logic.
Implement and maintain security baselines and industry benchmarks - Microsoft security baselines for Windows, Edge, and Defender; CIS Benchmarks; DISA STIG-derived controls - including deviation tracking, exception documentation, and drift detection.
Administer the Configuration Manager hierarchy: site systems, distribution points, boundary groups, client health, content distribution, task sequences, OS deployment, and hardware/software inventory accuracy.
Manage non-standard Windows endpoints - laboratory instrument PCs, manufacturing and shop-floor workstations, kiosks, shared and standalone systems - with tailored collections, restricted patch windows, exception handling, and documented deviations.
Identity, Conditional Access, and Endpoint Security
Manage device identity across Entra ID and on-premises Active Directory, including Hybrid Entra ID join, Entra ID join, AD domain-bound systems, and resolution of stale, duplicate, or mis-registered device objects.
Configure and maintain co-management settings, pilot collections, and the controlled transition of individual workloads (compliance policies, Windows Update, device configuration, client apps, Office Apps) from Configuration Manager to Intune.
Support Conditional Access in partnership with Identity and Information Security: device-based and compliance-based grant controls, filters for devices, app protection policy requirements, and safe rollout using report-only mode and exclusion groups.
Understand and support macOS Platform SSO with Entra ID - Secure Enclave authentication, local account creation and password sync, registration during Automated Device Enrollment - and the Microsoft Enterprise SSO plug-in for macOS and iOS/iPadOS.
Familiar with Zscaler Client Connector or comparable Zero Trust network access and secure web gateway agents across Windows and macOS.
Familiar with endpoint security controls, including Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, BitLocker and FileVault encryption with key escrow, application control, firewall policy, and Windows LAPS.
Deploy and maintain certificate profiles (SCEP/PKCS) and Wi-Fi (including 802.1X) across all supported platforms.
Endpoint Analytics, KPIs, and Reporting
Define, publish, and maintain endpoint management KPIs - patch compliance rate and time-to-patch, policy and compliance conformance, application deployment success rate, agent and client health.
Build operational and executive dashboards using Intune reporting, Configuration Manager reporting and SQL, Log Analytics, Microsoft Graph data extracts, and PowerBI.
Use AI-assisted engineering tools - Claude Code, Cowork, GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, and comparable agentic tooling - to accelerate script and policy development, log and error triage, documentation authoring, data analysis, and report generation.
Compliance, Quality, and Operational Support
Execute all platform and policy changes through the enterprise change management process, with documented impact assessment, test evidence, approvals, and rollback plans.
Support GxP-regulated endpoints by respecting validated system boundaries, coordinating with appropriate groups on change impact, and maintaining documentation sufficient to withstand internal audit and regulatory inspection.
Serve as escalation point for complex endpoint incidents from Endpoint Engineering Operations team and regional IT teams; perform root cause analysis and implement permanent corrective actions.
Maintain accurate technical documentation, standard operating procedures, work instructions, and knowledge base articles.
Participate in an on-call or extended-coverage rotation for critical endpoint incidents and scheduled maintenance activities.
Additional Skills & Qualifications
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent professional experience with relevant certifications will be considered.
Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience administering Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM) in an enterprise environment, including application packaging, OS deployment, and software update management.
Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience administering Microsoft Intune, including compliance policies, configuration profiles, security baselines, and application deployment.
Demonstrated proficiency writing and maintaining PowerShell for endpoint automation, remediation, and reporting - beyond running scripts written by others.
Practical experience with the Microsoft Graph API for endpoint management automation or reporting.
Working knowledge of Intune and Configuration Manager co-management, workload transition, Hybrid Entra ID join, and Active Directory domain-bound Windows endpoints.
Hands-on experience managing at least two non-Windows platforms in Intune (macOS, iOS/iPadOS, or Android), including scripting or shell-based configuration on macOS.
Working knowledge of Entra ID, Conditional Access, Group Policy, Active Directory, DNS/DHCP, PKI and certificate services, and Windows client architecture.
Experience deploying and troubleshooting endpoint security and network access agents (for example, Zscaler Client Connector, CrowdStrike).
Experience using endpoint reporting and analytics to measure and improve device health, compliance, or user experience (for example Intune report dashboards, Nexthink).
Working familiarity with AI-assisted development and productivity tools, and sound judgment about their appropriate use with enterprise data.
Experience operating within formal change management, incident management, and documentation standards.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills spanning identity, network, policy, and ap

The Basics:

Advanced Consulting Engineers (ACEs) are post-sale product experts that communicate technical nuances to assist Tanium customers as they articulate their business objectives . A highly experienced technical resource, ACEs are engaged by Customer Success to handle extraordinary customer engagement issues ( e.g. , stalled adoption) at Enterprise and Major accounts and may be l everaged by the broader account team for short-term engagements to p rovide product-specific guidance for advanced use cases.

What You'll Do:

- Business Objective Realization: Play a crucial role in the customer journey to operationalize business objectives and provide value realization in complex or stalled adoption.

- In-depth Knowledge Transfer: Involved in enabling end-users to effectively use Tanium products, to get past stalled adoption.

- Post-sales Technical Advisory: Support and document technical setup and configuration of complex products into runbooks, due to stalled adoption from the customer. Able to provide onsite technical assistance for support issues causing adoption and/or churn risk.

- Post-engagement Feedback: Following the engagement, provide documented feedback to Product, Engineering, Enablement, and Customer Service Operations.

We're Looking For:

- Education

- Associates degree or equivalent experience required

- Bachelor degree in Computer Science, MIS, or similar experience a plus

- Must Have

- 8+ years in the industry with solid technical skills in multiple areas such as networking, security, operations, scripting, and/or programming.

- Experience in one or more of the following technical domains: Endpoint Security, Endpoint Support/Troubleshooting, Incident Response, Systems Management, Utility Scripting (bash, PowerShell, VBScript, Python).

- Minimum 2 years of Tanium experience in one of the following: Endpoint Management, Security Operations, Exposure Management

- Prior experience and breadth of knowledge needed to lead customers and internal teams.

- Has mastered many new concepts and technologies; continually striving to master the Tanium platform and modules.

- Critical thinking and problem solving; can break problems down into manageable, ordered piece parts and masterfully convey the problem statement and plan to others. Thinks critically, spanning the customer lifecycle, and develops new capabilities on the Tanium platform with a high level of autonomy.

- Good Judgement; takes self-governed, consistent, action to prioritize and weigh cost and value in order to determine the action most appropriately aligned with the Tanium and our mission.

- Independent; can work on the most complex problems; should be able to complete tasks that are not well documented; participate in projects specific to their current skills and follow established technical support procedures only requiring help on more complex initiatives or issues.

- Communication; have mastered executive communication and demonstrate emotional intelligence, and patience, in all forms of communication. Anticipate blockers and delays for their work and the work of others, and communicate appropriately before requiring escalation.

- Influencing; demonstrate strong and consistent influence skills, working effectively with their team and strategic customers, to present logical and compelling arguments to enhance innovation and efficiencies.

- Informal Leadership; constructively lead in recognizing when conditions have changed and the team needs to adapt. This requires an attitude and drive that also leads the team in spotting emerging trends and patterns quickly, solving hard problems, and generating creative solutions.

- A deep sense of ownership in the work, no matter how small the task. Willing to jump into any effort to help the team succeed.

- A reputation within, and outside of, their team for being highly collaborative. They use this thinking to actively mentor and coach others to aid in their professional achievement and help avoid problems/high-risk behavior.

About the position

The Senior Endpoint Engineer will be responsible for supporting Intune administration and engineering, including compliance policies for conditional access, application deployment and patching, and management and troubleshooting. This role involves using Windows Update for Business to maintain workstation patch levels, creating and deploying Intune configurations, policies, and settings, and managing Windows 11 workstation baseline configurations. The engineer will also support and troubleshoot Windows Autopilot, identify and resolve system problems, package software and updates, develop security baselines, and create reports on device compliance, application deployment, patch management, and software inventory. Additionally, the role requires writing PowerShell scripts for automation, responding to escalated service desk requests, providing guidance to less-experienced engineers, communicating effectively, serving as a liaison with clients, and participating in special projects.

We are recruiting for a mission-driven End User Computing Engineer to join our team!
We're with you for life’s journey. At Denver Health, purpose isn’t just something we believe in—it’s something we live every day, for life’s journey.

Our Values

Respect | Belonging | Accountability | Transparency

Department

Information Technology

Job Summary

The End User Computing (EUC) Engineer is responsible for designing, supporting, maintaining, and optimizing the hospital's end user computing environment to ensure clinicians, staff, and administrators have reliable and secure access to technology resources. This role provides advanced technical support for endpoint devices, operating systems, applications, and mobility solutions, with a strong focus on delivering a stable, compliant, and user-friendly experience in a healthcare setting. The Engineer partners closely with clinical and non-clinical teams to address technology needs, troubleshoot complex issues, and contribute to projects that enhance patient care through technology.

Essential Functions:

Endpoint Deployment & Configuration
o Build, configure, and deploy desktops, laptops, tablets, thin clients, and mobile devices using enterprise imaging and management tools.
o Ensure devices meet hospital security, compliance, and operational standards prior to release.

(15%)Advanced Technical Support
o Provide Tier II/III support for escalated incidents, service requests, and problem management activities.
o Troubleshoot complex hardware, software, and peripheral issues in clinical and administrative environments.
o Partner with EUC Support and Help Desk teams to ensure resolution and knowledge transfer.
(15%)Systems & Application Management
o Administer and support Microsoft 365, Intune, SCCM, and other enterprise endpoint management solutions.
o Package, test, and deploy applications, patches, and updates to the endpoint environment.
o Maintain and optimize Group Policy Objects (GPOs), login scripts, and device configurations.
(15%)Healthcare Technology Integration
o Support clinical workstations, Workstations on Wheels (WoWs), printers, and medical-grade peripherals.
o Collaborate with clinical application teams (e.g., Epic Analysts, Nursing Informatics, Clin. Apps) to ensure endpoint compatibility, performance, and workflow support.
(15%)Security & Compliance
o Enforce endpoint security policies, including encryption, endpoint detection and response (EDR), conditional access, and mobile device management.
o Participate in vulnerability remediation, patch management, and compliance reporting activities.
o Support HIPAA and other regulatory requirements by ensuring endpoint security and data protection measures.
(15%)Project Participation & Execution
o Contribute to enterprise IT projects such as operating system upgrades, device lifecycle refreshes, and mobility initiatives.
o Assist with design, testing, and rollout of new endpoint standards, technologies, and configurations.
o Document project deliverables, lessons learned, and standard operating procedures.
(10%)Documentation & Knowledge Sharing
o Develop and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and knowledge base articles.
o Provide technical training and guidance to junior staff and end users as needed.
(10%)Continuous Improvement
o Monitor system performance, identify recurring issues, and recommend solutions to improve reliability and efficiency.
o Stay current with emerging EUC technologies, industry best practices, and healthcare IT trends.
(5%)
Education:

Bachelor's Degree Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field required; equivalent work experience accepted in lieu of degree.
Work Experience:

7-9 years of IT experience with at least 5 years focused on end user computing required.
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

Proficiency in Microsoft 365, Windows Operating Systems, Intune, SCCM, Active Directory, Group Policy.Experience with mobile device management (MDM/MAM), such as Intune, JAMF or Citrix XenMobile.Familiarity with clinical workflows and healthcare endpoint technologies.Strong troubleshooting skills in hardware, OS, and application environments.

Shift

Days (United States of America)

Regular

Salary

$88,800.00 - $137,600.00 / yr

Benefits

At Denver Health, we take care of the people who take care of our community. Our benefits are built to support your life, your family, and your future — with generous paid time off, fully paid parental leave, exceptional retirement contributions, comprehensive health coverage, and nationally recognized well-being programs. We invest in your growth through tuition assistance, career advancement pathways, and professional development — while also offering meaningful financial advantages through loan forgiveness eligibility and employer contributions. When you join Denver Health, you’re joining a mission-driven organization that invests in you.

Here is a small list of our benefit programs:

Paid time off starting at 28 days per year, inclusive of vacation, personal/sick, and 7 Holidays 100% paid parental leave up to 6 weeks Immediate eligibility for retirement plans with employer contribution up to 9.5% Generous medical, dental, vision plans in addition to employer paid disability and life insurance. Denver Health is an integrated, high-quality academic healthcare system considered a model for the nation that includes a Level I Trauma Center, a 555-bed acute care medical center, Denver’s 911 emergency medical response system, 10 family health centers, 19 school-based health centers, Rocky Mountain Poison & Drug Safety, the Public Health Institute at Denver Health, Denver Health Medical Plan and Denver Health Foundation.

Located near downtown Denver, Denver Health is just minutes away from many of the cultural and recreational activities Denver has to offer.

Denver Health is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). We value the unique ideas, talents and contributions reflective of the needs of our community. All job applicants for safety-sensitive positions must pass a pre-employment drug test, once a conditional offer of employment has been made. Applicants will be considered until the position is filled.

jobs.description:
Description

We are seeking an Endpoint Management Engineer to design, automate, and operate the enterprise device management platform supporting our global workforce, laboratories, manufacturing sites, and commercial field organization. This role owns hands-on engineering and operations across Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM) in a co-management architecture, with Hybrid Entra ID (Azure AD) joined, Active Directory domain-bound Windows endpoints and a multi-platform Intune estate spanning Windows, macOS, iOS/iPadOS, and Android — including Android-based teleconferencing and conference room systems.

Automation is central to this role. The successful candidate writes production-quality PowerShell, Bash, and .NET code, builds Intune remediation and detection scripts, and uses the Microsoft Graph API to manage the estate programmatically rather than soley through the console. We also expect fluency with modern AI-assisted engineering tools — including Claude or CoPilot — to accelerate script development, log analysis, documentation, and reporting.

Equally important is the discipline required in a regulated pharmaceutical environment. You will advance modern management objectives — Zero Trust, Conditional Access, cloud-first policy delivery, and progressive workload migration from Configuration Manager to Intune — while respecting the reliability requirements of standard corporate devices and the constraints of non-standard, purpose-built systems such as laboratory instrument controllers, manufacturing workstations, kiosks, and validated GxP endpoints. The role partners closely with Information Security, Identity, Networking, Infrastructure, Site IT, and Site Service Support teams.

Key Responsibilities

Automation, Scripting, and Development

• Design, write, and maintain production-quality PowerShell for endpoint provisioning, configuration enforcement, bulk administration, reporting, and incident remediation across the Windows estate.

• Write and maintain shell/Bash scripts for macOS configuration, compliance validation, and application delivery through Intune macOS shell scripting.

• Build and manage Intune Remediations (proactive remediations) — paired detection and remediation script logic — to identify and self-heal configuration drift, failed agents, certificate issues, and compliance gaps without user impact.

• Automate platform operations against the Microsoft Graph API, including device and policy inventory, assignment management, application lifecycle tasks, reporting extracts, and integration with adjacent systems.

• Apply engineering discipline to automation assets: source control, code review, parameterization, error handling, logging, idempotency, and controlled release through test rings.

• Convert recurring manual and Service Desk activities into automated or self-service capabilities.

Core Device Management

• Engineer and maintain Intune compliance policies across all platforms, including device health, OS version floors, and custom compliance scripts.

• Build and maintain configuration profiles and settings catalog policies, administrative templates, and custom OMA-URI/configuration profiles for Windows, macOS, iOS/iPadOS, and Android.

• Familiar with Windows Update for Business and update rings, feature and quality update deployments, driver and firmware update governance, macOS and iOS update policies.

• Manage monthly and out-of-band patch operations in Configuration Manager through Software Update Groups, automatic deployment rules, and maintenance windows; drive patch compliance to defined service-level targets and remediate delinquent endpoints.

• Package, test, and deploy applications across platforms — Win32 (.intunewin), MSI/MSIX, Microsoft Store, Microsoft 365 Apps, macOS PKG/DMG and shell-script apps, iOS/Android managed apps via volume purchasing — with correct detection rules, dependencies, supersedence, requirement rules, and assignment logic.

• Implement and maintain security baselines and industry benchmarks — Microsoft security baselines for Windows, Edge, and Defender; CIS Benchmarks; DISA STIG-derived controls — including deviation tracking, exception documentation, and drift detection.

• Administer the Configuration Manager hierarchy: site systems, distribution points, boundary groups, client health, content distribution, task sequences, OS deployment, and hardware/software inventory accuracy.

• Manage non-standard Windows endpoints — laboratory instrument PCs, manufacturing and shop-floor workstations, kiosks, shared and standalone systems — with tailored collections, restricted patch windows, exception handling, and documented deviations.

Identity, Conditional Access, and Endpoint Security

• Manage device identity across Entra ID and on-premises Active Directory, including Hybrid Entra ID join, Entra ID join, AD domain-bound systems, and resolution of stale, duplicate, or mis-registered device objects.

• Configure and maintain co-management settings, pilot collections, and the controlled transition of individual workloads (compliance policies, Windows Update, device configuration, client apps, Office Apps) from Configuration Manager to Intune.

• Support Conditional Access in partnership with Identity and Information Security: device-based and compliance-based grant controls, filters for devices, app protection policy requirements, and safe rollout using report-only mode and exclusion groups.

• Understand and support macOS Platform SSO with Entra ID — Secure Enclave authentication, local account creation and password sync, registration during Automated Device Enrollment — and the Microsoft Enterprise SSO plug-in for macOS and iOS/iPadOS.

• Familiar with Zscaler Client Connector or comparable Zero Trust network access and secure web gateway agents across Windows and macOS.

• Familiar with endpoint security controls, including Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, BitLocker and FileVault encryption with key escrow, application control, firewall policy, and Windows LAPS.

• Deploy and maintain certificate profiles (SCEP/PKCS) and Wi-Fi (including 802.1X) across all supported platforms.

Endpoint Analytics, KPIs, and Reporting

• Define, publish, and maintain endpoint management KPIs — patch compliance rate and time-to-patch, policy and compliance conformance, application deployment success rate, agent and client health.

• Build operational and executive dashboards using Intune reporting, Configuration Manager reporting and SQL, Log Analytics, Microsoft Graph data extracts, and PowerBI.

• Use AI-assisted engineering tools — Claude Code, Cowork, GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, and comparable agentic tooling — to accelerate script and policy development, log and error triage, documentation authoring, data analysis, and report generation.

Compliance, Quality, and Operational Support

• Execute all platform and policy changes through the enterprise change management process, with documented impact assessment, test evidence, approvals, and rollback plans.

• Support GxP-regulated endpoints by respecting validated system boundaries, coordinating with appropriate groups on change impact, and maintaining documentation sufficient to withstand internal audit and regulatory inspection.

• Serve as escalation point for complex endpoint incidents from Endpoint Engineering Operations team and regional IT teams; perform root cause analysis and implement permanent corrective actions.

• Maintain accurate technical documentation, standard operating procedures, work instructions, and knowledge base articles.

• Participate in an on-call or extended-coverage rotation for critical endpoint incidents and scheduled maintenance activities.

Additional Skills & Qualifications

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent professional experience with relevant certifications will be considered.

• Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience administering Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM) in an enterprise environment, including application packaging, OS deployment, and software update management.

• Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience administering Microsoft Intune, including compliance policies, configuration profiles, security baselines, and application deployment.

• Demonstrated proficiency writing and maintaining PowerShell for endpoint automation, remediation, and reporting — beyond running scripts written by others.

• Practical experience with the Microsoft Graph API for endpoint management automation or reporting.

• Working knowledge of Intune and Configuration Manager co-management, workload transition, Hybrid Entra ID join, and Active Directory domain-bound Windows endpoints.

• Hands-on experience managing at least two non-Windows platforms in Intune (macOS, iOS/iPadOS, or Android), including scripting or shell-based configuration on macOS.

• Working knowledge of Entra ID, Conditional Access, Group Policy, Active Directory, DNS/DHCP, PKI and certificate services, and Windows client architecture.

• Experience deploying and troubleshooting endpoint security and network access agents (for example, Zscaler Client Connector, CrowdStrike).

• Experience using endpoint reporting and analytics to measure and improve device health, compliance, or user experience (for example Intune report dashboards, Nexthink).

• Working familiarity with AI-assisted development and productivity tools, and sound judgment about their appropriate use with enterprise data.

• Experience operating within formal change management, incident management, and documentation standards.

• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills spanning identity, network, policy, and ap

jobs.description:
Description
The Senior macOS Systems Engineer is responsible for engineering, maintaining, automating, and securing the organization’s macOS endpoint ecosystem and supporting infrastructure. This role serves as the senior technical resource for macOS device management, endpoint security, automation, and enterprise client engineering initiatives.

The role operates within the Endpoint Engineering team and is focused on delivering scalable, secure, and modern endpoint management solutions for macOS devices across the global enterprise environment. Responsibilities include endpoint lifecycle management, operating system deployment, application packaging, patch management, security compliance, automation, and platform optimization.

This position requires strong engineering capabilities, deep macOS platform expertise, and the ability to lead complex technical initiatives while supporting operational stability and modernization efforts across endpoint services.

Responsibilities
Endpoint Engineering & Platform Management

Serve as the senior macOS subject matter expert for endpoint engineering operations and escalations. Engineer, maintain, and optimize enterprise macOS management platforms including Jamf Pro and/or Iru. Design and maintain scalable endpoint provisioning and lifecycle management workflows within cloud identity environments. Manage and support macOS operating system deployment, configuration management, software deployment, and patch management processes. Maintain standardized endpoint configurations and enforce enterprise device compliance standards.

Automation & Scripting

Develop and maintain automation workflows, scripts, and tooling to improve endpoint operational efficiency and reduce manual administrative overhead. Create and maintain application packaging, deployment automation, and self-service solutions for enterprise software delivery. Write and maintain advanced Bash and Python scripts to support provisioning, compliance, reporting, monitoring, and remediation tasks. Identify opportunities for automation and continuous improvement across endpoint operations.

Security & Compliance

Partner with Information Security teams to implement and maintain macOS security baselines and endpoint hardening standards. Engineer and maintain automated patching and vulnerability remediation processes. Support endpoint compliance initiatives and assist in responding to security incidents and critical vulnerabilities. Ensure endpoint management platforms align with enterprise security, auditing, and governance requirements.

Infrastructure & Operations

Monitor endpoint management platform performance, availability, and operational health. Troubleshoot and resolve complex endpoint engineering and infrastructure issues. Maintain and optimize management platform architecture in alignment with business growth and operational requirements. Participate in platform upgrades, testing, validation, and rollout activities.

Collaboration & Support

Provide Tier 3 escalation support for Service Desk and technical support teams. Collaborate with infrastructure, identity, networking, and security teams to implement integrated endpoint solutions. Work closely with business stakeholders to evaluate and deliver endpoint solutions supporting operational and business initiatives. Mentor junior engineers and contribute technical leadership within the Endpoint Engineering team.

Documentation & Standards

Create and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, engineering standards, and platform architecture documentation. Contribute to endpoint engineering best practices, governance standards, and operational maturity initiatives. Maintain accurate documentation for configurations, workflows, integrations, and support processes.

Qualifications
Experience

5+ years of experience supporting and engineering enterprise macOS environments. 5+ years of hands-on experience administering Jamf Pro, Iru (Kandji) platforms. Experience managing large-scale enterprise endpoint environments supporting 1000+ users. Experience supporting modern endpoint management and cloud identity platforms.

Technical Expertise

Advanced knowledge of macOS administration, configuration, and troubleshooting. Strong experience with Jamf Pro, Iru(Kandji) architecture, administration, and maintenance. Experience with macOS application packaging and deployment methodologies. Advanced knowledge of endpoint patch management concepts and methodologies. Strong scripting experience using Bash and Python. Working knowledge of Apple Business Manager, automated device enrolment, and MDM technologies. Experience integrating endpoint platforms with identity providers such as Azure AD / Entra ID or Okta. Solid networking fundamentals and troubleshooting skills. Experience with ServiceNow and JIRA ticketing and workflow systems. Knowledge of endpoint security best practices and modern cybersecurity principles. Experience with endpoint compliance, monitoring, and reporting.

Preferred Qualifications

JAMF Pro 200 certification or higher. Apple platform certifications preferred. Experience with cloud-first endpoint management strategies. Familiarity with Microsoft Intune and cross-platform endpoint management concepts. Experience with automation frameworks and infrastructure modernization initiatives.

Key Competencies

Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Automation-first engineering mindset. Ability to operate independently in complex enterprise environments. Strong technical communication and documentation skills. Ability to prioritize and manage multiple initiatives simultaneously. Collaborative approach to cross-functional engineering and operational work. Strong focus on platform reliability, scalability, and operational excellence.

jobs.description:
Remote, OR, USA | Full Time

Senior Systems Engineer (Windows)

Remote, USA

EMKS is seeking a Senior Systems Engineer to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Independent Enterprise Testing Support Services (IETSS) contract. This project provides Independent Verification and Validation (IV&V) services to support the product Software Delivery Life Cycle and Modernization efforts on behalf of our Veterans Affairs (VA) government client. In our continuing efforts to implement more of our IV&V activities, we are seeking a Sr. Windows Systems Engineer.

The Sr.Windows Systems Engineer is responsible for the administration, maintenance, support, and lifecycle management of Windows-based infrastructure supporting a large federal testing environment. This role provides Level 3 technical support for Windows servers, virtualization platforms, application hosting, and infrastructure services while collaborating with databases, Linux, network, and testing teams. The position supports a non-production environment consisting of system integration, functional, performance, and quality assurance testing systems. The administrator will be responsible for maintaining system reliability, supporting testing teams, troubleshooting complex issues, and participating in infrastructure modernization and automation initiatives.

Duties/Responsibilities:

Administer, maintain, and support Windows Server 2019, 2022, and 2025 environments, including Windows workstation environments as needed.

Build, configure, maintain, upgrade, migrate, and decommission Windows systems in accordance with established standards and operational requirements.

Maintain standardized system templates, configurations, file shares, Windows services, and related infrastructure documentation.

Provision, manage, and troubleshoot virtual machines and hosted services within VMware-based environments.

Monitor server capacity, disk space, memory, CPU, performance, and resource utilization to ensure systems remain available and responsive for testing activities.

Provide Level 3 troubleshooting for operating system, application hosting, service interruption, performance degradation, and infrastructure-related issues.

Support Windows-hosted testing tools and application environments, including installations, upgrades, configuration changes, access support, and issue resolution.

Support Broadcom development and testing environments, including installations, access management, and technical issue resolution.

Manage IIS and application certificates, including certificate deployment, renewal, lifecycle coordination, and troubleshooting using Venafi or similar certificate management tools.

Develop, maintain, and improve PowerShell scripts and automation solutions to streamline system administration and operational processes.

Respond to monitoring alerts, investigate outages or degraded services, participate in root cause analysis, and coordinate remediation with database, Linux, network, security, and application teams.

Support vulnerability remediation, operating system patching, security updates, BitLocker management, and compliance with organizational security requirements.

Support server access requests, permissions management, Active Directory groups, and local security groups.

Provide advanced technical support to testing personnel and cross-functional technical teams in a non-production federal testing environment.

Excellent oral and written communication skills, with the ability to document technical issues, coordinate across teams, and communicate clearly with stakeholders.

Required Technical/Business Tools Experience:

Windows Server administration tools and environments, including Windows Server 2019, 2022, and 2025.

VMware or equivalent virtualization platform for provisioning, managing, and troubleshooting virtual machines.

Active Directory, group permissions, local security groups, and access management tools.

PowerShell or equivalent scripting/automation tools used to support system administration activities.

IIS and Windows-based application hosting environments.

Certificate management tools such as Venafi or equivalent platforms.

Monitoring, alerting, and troubleshooting tools used to assess system health, performance, capacity, and availability.

Patch management, vulnerability remediation, and endpoint/security compliance tools.

Ticketing, service management, and change management tools used to document work, track incidents, and coordinate support activities.

Microsoft Office, Microsoft Teams, and SharePoint for documentation, collaboration, communication, and reporting.

Education/Certifications:

Bachelor's degree in a technical, engineering, scientific, managerial, business, or related discipline; four years of equivalent documented experience or an Associate's Decree with two years of experience may be substituted for the Bachelor's degree.

Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate is desired.

VMware Certified Professional – Data Center Virtualization is desired.

Clearance:

U.S. Citizenship is required as is successfully passing a thorough Government background screening requiring the completion of detailed forms and fingerprinting.

Ability to obtain and maintain necessary security clearances as required for access to classified information.

Founded in 2015, EM Key Solutions, Inc. Build more than infrastructure. Help power the future of healthcare.

As Manager of IT Infrastructure and Digital Workplace, you will partner with executive leadership to advance strategy, strengthen resiliency, improve technology platforms, and maintain the modern infrastructure that keeps caregivers connected with one another, and patients, every day. At Salem Health, your deep experience in server operations, network engineering, and large systems will contribute to the continuous growth and improvement of one of Oregon's leading healthcare organizations.

This highly visible leadership role oversees approximately 35 team members across systems operations, networking, telecommunications, and the digital workplace. You will lead experienced technical teams, develop future leaders, and help drive innovation across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.

Beyond operations, you will play a key role in forecasting infrastructure modernization, disaster recovery, cybersecurity preparedness, and enterprise resiliency initiatives, helping ensure Salem Health is ready for both today's challenges and tomorrow's opportunities.

Lead with Impact. Live with Balance.

Salem Health offers the opportunity to lead meaningful work while enjoying an exceptional quality of life. Located in the heart of the Willamette Valley, you will enjoy easy access to Oregon wine country, the Pacific Coast, mountain recreation, vibrant communities, highly rated schools, and Portland's amenities, all while benefiting from a more affordable and accessible lifestyle than many larger West Coast markets.

At Salem Health, you can build an influential career, develop talented teams, and make a lasting impact on healthcare technology while enjoying the balance that makes the Pacific Northwest such an exceptional place to call home.

What You Will Do

Strategic Leadership & Innovation

Partner with the Chief Technology Officer/Chief Information Security Officer to define and operationalize long‑term infrastructure and digital workplace strategies.Lead strategy development for your area of oversight and drive execution across multiple initiatives.Maintain and evolve strategy maps for infrastructure functions.Stay current on workplace, infrastructure, and cloud trends; evaluate emerging technologies and integrate solutions aligned with business outcomes.Advance organizational resiliency initiatives, including preparedness for natural disasters, cyber threats, and system recovery.

Team & Resource Leadership

Lead a department of approximately 35 employees, including three managers and technical teams spanning networking, systems operations, and the digital workplace.Provide coaching, mentoring, and development pathways, especially for high‑tenure teams with diverse viewpoints and skill sets.Foster a leadership culture centered on collaboration, listening, and frontline engagement; not top‑down directive management.Support retention, succession planning, and healthy team dynamics.Oversee consultants and vendor relationships across reporting departments.

Operational Excellence

Ensure reliable, secure operation of all core IT infrastructure and services across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments.Oversee platforms including compute, storage, telecom, WAN, networking, endpoints, unified communications, Microsoft 365, collaboration tools, and digital workplace solutions.Manage capacity, resource allocation, and day‑to‑day service performance.Lead and mature disaster recovery processes and testing.Drive modernization of WAN technologies to increase resiliency and performance.Identify and remediate technical debt through proactive monitoring and structured assessments.Support the service desk through strong alignment, clear communication, and operational readiness.

Financial & Vendor Management

Oversee division budgets and capital planning activities.Lead cost‑savings initiatives with measurable process and outcome metrics.Ensure vendors meet SLA expectations and deliver cost‑effective, high‑quality services.

Security, Risk & Compliance

Partner with Information Security to ensure all infrastructure and workplace platforms align with cybersecurity standards.Maintain compliance with regulatory and accrediting bodies (e.g., CMS, Joint Commission, HIPAA).Support organization‑wide risk management practices and system hardening.

Continuous Improvement

Apply Lean/Kaizen methodologies to drive measurable improvements in operations, efficiency, and user experience.Act as a Lean Sensei for multiple team members, fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Leadership On‑Call

Participate in the enterprise‑wide IS leadership on‑call rotation (approximately every 16 weeks).Provide high‑level decision support for critical after‑hours incidents and escalations.

What We're Looking For

Technical & Strategic Abilities

Experience working in, and strong familiarity with, on-premises infrastructure footprints, including technical debt prioritization.Ability to manage DR/resilience design when a critical system, such as the EMR, is hosted by a third party outside of the organization’s direct infrastructure control.Strategic foresight to consider resilience and continuity when critical systems run on infrastructure owned outside the organization.Ability to evaluate emerging technologies and align them with organizational strategy and real‑world constraints.Familiarity with resiliency planning, disaster recovery, and enterprise risk management.A balanced orientation toward technical depth, operational excellence, and people leadership.

Background & Experience

Progressive experience that demonstrates both technical competency and leadership capability, not exclusively long‑tenured management without hands‑on technical grounding.Demonstrated success partnering across complex organizations, particularly in healthcare or other highly regulated industries.

Leadership & Behavioral Strengths

A collaborative, people‑centered leadership style that values input from frontline experts.Ability to navigate differing opinions, especially among highly skilled, high‑tenure technical staff, with diplomacy and clarity.Strong relationship‑building skills across clinical, technical, and operational teams.Comfort balancing strategic vision with operational needs, jumping in where needed to “keep the lights on.”High emotional intelligence, sound judgment, and the ability to establish trust quickly.

Required Qualifications

Master's degree. Eight years of professional experience within technology, preferably in a hospital or clinical setting. Five years of experience in management of complex projects and implementation of systems. Five years of experience managing projects and/or applications. Three years of manager or director-level experience.

Why Salem Health?

Salem Health is a Top Workplace in Oregon, known for fostering a supportive culture where your contributions truly matter. As an award-winning, independent health care system, we serve our region through Salem Hospital, multiple community clinics and West Valley Hospital, ensuring broad access to high-quality care.

We believe in empowering our teams. Through Lean principles, staff help drive innovation and solve real problems. We also invest in your growth with professional development, tuition assistance, and clear career pathways. At Salem Health, you’ll find more than a job, you’ll find purpose, connection, and room to thrive.

Salem Health Hospitals and Clinics is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status or condition protected by law.

Salem Health Hospitals and Clinics is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for applicants. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact my.recruiter@salemhealth.org.

## Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Mission Systems is a trusted provider of mission-enabling solutions for global security. Our Engineering and Sciences (E&S) organization pushes the boundaries of innovation, redefines engineering capabilities, and drives advances in various sciences. Our team is chartered by providing the skills and innovative technologies to develop, design, produce and sustain optimized product lines across the sector while providing a decisive advantage to the warfighter. Come be a part of our mission!

Northrop Grumman Mission Systems has an opening for a systems engineer in the cyber specialty discipline. We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Principal Cyber Systems Engineer or Senior Principal Cyber Systems Engineer to join our dynamic engineering team. This role involves serving on a team dedicated to the development of a new solution operating in a multi-level security environment. The position requires expertise in Cyber Systems Engineering along with some networking experience.

The qualified applicant will become part of Northrop Grumman’s Mission Systems support team in San Antonio, TX.

**This position may be filled by either at the Principal Cyber Systems Engineer level OR at the Sr. Principal Cyber Systems Engineer level based on the qualifications listed.**

Please Note: Due to the classified nature of the work being performed, this position does not offer any virtual or telecommute working options. Applicants are encouraged to apply, only if they are willing to work 100% on-site.

What you’ll get to Do:

Join a multi‑disciplinary team designing and securing a launch execution network - a complex, multi‑enclave launch and missile test environment. As a cyber‑strong systems engineer with solid networking skills, you will own the security architecture and RMF/ATO posture for networked systems, shaping controls, documentation, and automation that keep mission systems both secure and available. This role is on‑site full‑time in San Antonio, TX and requires an active TS and SCI eligibility.

* Work with customer ISSMs/ISSOs and other stakeholders to develop, document, and implement changes in environments operating under, or seeking, an ATO/IATT in accordance with DoD RMF.
* Serve as a cyber systems engineer on a multi disciplinary team, collaborating closely with network, systems, software, and test engineers to design and secure complex, multi enclave launch and test networks (classified and unclassified).
* Review and influence network architectures and detailed designs (routing, switching, VPN/IPsec, segmentation, boundary defenses) from a cybersecurity perspective, ensuring baked in protections and RMF compliant control implementations.
* Support the design, planning, configuration, and sustainment of enterprise scale network communications and security services, producing and maintaining engineering artifacts such as security and network diagrams, configuration baselines, and implementation plans.
* Provide cybersecurity systems engineering guidance and oversight to implementation teams, including secure configuration of Microsoft and Linux systems, network devices, and enclave services (e.g., logging/monitoring, KMS/PKI, endpoint protection).
* Plan and support end to end testing of security and network designs, validate configurations, and monitor performance to ensure reliability, resiliency, and compliance with security policies and RMF control objectives.
* Support vulnerability management activities (scanning, analysis, remediation planning, and compensating controls) in mission critical environments with constrained maintenance windows.
* Leverage automation and scripting (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Ansible, Terraform) to implement and enforce secure configurations, generate compliance evidence, and streamline recurring cyber engineering tasks.
* Perform or oversee physical layer installation tasks (e.g., fiber, patch panels, encryption devices) as needed to support secure infrastructure builds and changes.
* Produce periodic status reports, risk/issue summaries, and engineering change documentation; clearly communicate technical options, risks, and trade offs to both technical and non technical stakeholders, including customer representatives.

Note: This position can be filled at the Principal or Sr. Principal level.

Basic Qualifications for a Principal Cyber Systems Engineer:

* Bachelor’s degree in a Science in a STEM discipline from an accredited institution and 5 years of related experience in engineering; or a Master’s degree in a STEM discipline and 3 years of related experience; or a Ph.D. in a STEM discipline and 1 year of related experience.
* US Citizenship is required
* Active, current DoD Top Secret security clearance and SCI eligibility
* DoD 8570 IAT Level II certification (e.g., Security+ CE) or equivalent prior to start.
* Hands‑on experience as a cyber/security engineer or cyber systems engineer for complex networked systems (preferably DoD or similar)
* Experience applying the Risk Management Framework (RMF)
* Experience developing and/or implementing security controls for Microsoft and Linux systems
* Working knowledge of IP networking (e.g., routing, switching, VLANs, firewalls) sufficient to read, understand, and critique network designs in collaboration with dedicated network engineers.

Basic Qualifications for a Senior Principal Cyber Systems Engineer:

* Bachelor’s degree in a Science in a STEM discipline from an accredited institution and 8 years of related experience in engineering; or a Master’s degree in a STEM discipline and 6 years of related experience; or a Ph.D. in a STEM discipline and 3 year of related experience.
* US Citizenship is required
* Active, current DoD Top Secret security clearance and SCI eligibility
* DoD 8570 IAT Level II certification (e.g., Security+ CE) or equivalent prior to start.
* Hands‑on experience as a cyber/security engineer or cyber systems engineer for complex networked systems (preferably DoD or similar)
* Experience applying the Risk Management Framework (RMF)
* Experience developing and/or implementing security controls for Microsoft and Linux systems
* Working knowledge of IP networking (e.g., routing, switching, VLANs, firewalls) sufficient to read, understand, and critique network designs in collaboration with dedicated network engineers.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Strong working knowledge of IP networking (e.g., routing, switching, VPN/IPsec, DNS, DHCP, NTP, segmentation) and secure network design principles (defense‑in‑depth, least privilege), with experience applying host and network hardening standards (e.g., DISA STIGs, CIS benchmarks) across servers, endpoints, and network devices.
* Experience building baseline security control sets and secure configurations for core infrastructure (e.g., routers/switches, firewalls, IDS/IPS, EDR/antivirus, logging) and integrating these into a SIEM‑driven NOC/SOC construct for unified monitoring and incident response.
* Hands‑on experience with vulnerability scanning and remediation in mission‑critical or real‑time environments with constrained maintenance windows, including implementing compensating controls when direct remediation is not immediately feasible.
* Strong understanding of Zero Trust concepts, access‑control models (RBAC/ABAC), and secure management‑plane design for networked mission systems.
* Experience architecting and implementing enterprise Key Management Systems (KMS) and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), including HSM integration (FIPS 140‑2/3), key hierarchies (root, KEK, DEK), certificate lifecycle management, and repeatable deployment patterns for enclave services (KMS, PKI, logging, monitoring).
* Familiarity with NIST cryptographic guidance (e.g., SP 800‑57, SP 800‑38 series) and experience aligning cryptographic implementations to DoD/IC requirements.
* Demonstrated experience executing the RMF lifecycle (Steps 0–6) for complex systems, including development of SSPs, security assessment/test plans, POA&Ms, and other authorization artifacts, and responding to AO/ISSM/ISSO comments and findings.
* Experience using automation and infrastructure‑as‑code (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Ansible, Terraform) to manage network and security configurations, enforce standards, and generate repeatable compliance evidence.
* Experience securing cloud or edge‑computing environments (e.g., AWS, Azure, GovCloud and/or containerized/microservices architectures such as Kubernetes and Docker), including segmentation, control‑plane protection, and integration with enterprise monitoring.
* Experience working in Agile or DevSecOps environments, collaborating with network, systems, and software teams to integrate security into architecture/design and CI/CD pipelines; familiarity with MBSE/digital engineering tools to capture security requirements and behaviors.
* Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to produce clear engineering artifacts (designs, diagrams, ICDs, risk summaries) and to brief leadership, customer representatives, and authorization officials on risk trade‑offs, mitigations, and accreditation posture.
