This role requires expertise in systems engineering, cloud migration, and infrastructure automation to enhance security and efficiency. You will collaborate across teams to develop robust identity and access management frameworks and optimize configuration management processes. Your contributions will ensure reliable, secure, and high-performing infrastructure that aligns with Walmart’s strategic objectives and supports ongoing innovation.

About the team:

The Enterprise Directory Services Core team oversees Walmart’s multiple Active Directory forests, ensuring secure and efficient LDAP services. This team maintains a stable, well-protected Active Directory environment, demonstrating operational excellence. It provides consulting support to application teams by sharing best practices and resolving application-related issues. Focused on reliability, security, modernization, and collaboration, the team plays a crucial role in sustaining the infrastructure that supports Walmart’s business operations. Their expertise includes systems engineering, cloud migration, configuration management, and security systems, enabling seamless and secure IT service delivery aligned with organizational goals.

What you'll do...Support the design, security, and management of Active Directory and support hybrid identity systems. This role contributes to identity modernization, architecture standards, automation, and resilient directory services across large-scale infrastructure.

Provide technical leadership and hands-on support for enterprise Active Directory services across multi-domain, multi-forest, and hybrid identity environments.
Contribute to modernization of domain controller infrastructure through service optimization initiatives.
Support enterprise identity modernization by helping integrate Active Directory with cloud-based identity platforms and reduce legacy authentication dependencies.
Develop and maintain automation frameworks, monitoring platforms, and alerting solutions that improve operational efficiency.
Provide mentorship, technical guidance, and escalation support for engineers.

What you'll bring:

Solid experience in IT infrastructure, Enterprise IAM, Active Directory, cloud-based identity, and access management adoption.
Proven expertise in systems engineering, infrastructure maintenance, and configuration management.
Proficiency in scripting languages such as PowerShell, JavaScript and Python to automate operational tasks.
Ability to analyze infrastructure performance metrics and develop capacity plans aligned with business requirements.
Familiarity with version control, release verification, and integration management using middleware and APIs.
Understanding of architectural principles and design patterns for scalable, secure systems.
Hands-on experience managing Active Directory and Active Directory Lightweight Directory Services for enterprise environments.
Software engineering skills to support integration and development of infrastructure components.

jobs.title: Endpoint Management Engineer
jobs.summary: The Endpoint Management Engineer is responsible for ensuring that all managed workstations across the firm consistently receive and successfully apply required software deployments — including application updates, operating system patches, BIOS/firmware...
jobs.description:
The Endpoint Management Engineer is responsible for ensuring that all managed workstations across the firm consistently receive and successfully apply required software deployments — including application updates, operating system patches, BIOS/firmware updates, and hardware driver updates. This role serves as the deployment authority for the workstation environment: owning the deployment calendar, coordinating release timing with other engineers, and ensuring that all workstation deployments are accompanied by the appropriate change control documentation. The role maintains a strong compliance posture by monitoring deployment success rates, identifying and remediating gaps, and validating that updates reach their intended targets across both Windows and macOS endpoints within established timeframes. The individual in this role operates with a high degree of independence, self directs their workload, and is capable of leading projects from inception through completion with minimal oversight. Forthe full job description, please click on the More Info icon.
Duties and Responsibilities
Primary

Serves as the deployment authority for the workstation environment — owns the deployment calendar and coordinates with other engineers across the group to determine scheduling and sequencing for all software, update, and configuration deployments pushed to firm workstations.Creates and manages change control tickets for all workstation deployments in accordance with firm change management policy, ensuring that required documentation, approvals, and risk assessments are completed prior to deployment.Monitors and enforces workstation software compliance for all deployed applications, operating system updates, BIOS/firmware updates, and hardware driver updates across the firm's managed Windows and macOS device fleet.Tracks deployment success rates via SCCM/ConfigMgr, Intune, and Jamf Pro; identifies noncompliant, unreachable, or failing endpoints and drives remediation to closure.Owns the deployment pipeline for BIOS/firmware and driver updates across the Windows device fleet, including packaging, testing, staged rollout, and post-deployment validation (primarily Lenovo hardware).Manages macOS workstation compliance in Jamf Pro, including application deployment, macOS update enforcement, configuration profile compliance, and device inventory accuracy.Prioritizes security-relevant application and OS updates to ensure timely workstation delivery in alignment with firm policy; coordinates with information security when patch timelines or compliance gaps require escalation.Partners with information security as needed to provide deployment compliance data, reporting, and evidence for audits or vulnerability management reviews — serving as the subject-matter expert on workstation software state.Develops and maintains compliance dashboards and reporting for software update health across Windows and macOS endpoints, highlighting trends, persistent failures, and remediation status for IT leadership.Authors and maintains deployment runbooks, compliance procedures, and exception-handling documentation to support consistent operations and knowledge transfer.Identifies systemic causes of deployment failures (e.g., client health issues, network constraints, policy conflicts, Jamf enrollment gaps) and implements durable solutions rather than one-off fixes.Leads projects independently as required — defining scope, coordinating stakeholders, managing timelines, and delivering outcomes with minimal direct oversight.Collaborates with the Applications Engineering team on new application deployments to build compliance monitoring into rollouts from the outset, for both Windows and macOS platforms.Evaluates and recommends tooling improvements or process enhancements that increase deployment reliability and compliance visibility across the full workstation fleet.Provides escalation support for complex deployment or compliance issues affecting end-user productivity.Develops and maintains end-user communications and guidance aimed at improving update compliance — including messaging around device availability during deployment windows — and works collaboratively with end users to identify software gaps and develop practical solutions that increase overall compliance rates.
Secondary
Performs other duties as assigned.
Minimum Qualification
Education
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience in the computer/technical industry.
Experience
5–8 years of experience in endpoint or workstation management, systems administration, or IT operations with a demonstrable focus on patch management, software deployment, and compliance across Windows environments. Experience with macOS management is a plus. Experience in a law firm or professional services environment is preferred.
Special Knowledge
Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (SCCM/ConfigMgr), Windows Server Update Services (WSUS), Microsoft Intune, Active Directory, and Group Policy. Jamf Pro for macOS workstation management, including policy deployment, configuration profiles, and patch enforcement. Familiarity with CyberArk EPM or similar endpoint privilege management tools. Knowledge of BIOS/UEFI firmware update mechanisms and hardware driver management, preferably in a Lenovo environment. Familiarity with Azure services including Entra ID is a plus.
Technical Skills
Proficiency with PowerShell scripting for automation of compliance reporting, remediation tasks, and deployment workflows on Windows. Familiarity with Bash or shell scripting for macOS automation within Jamf is a plus. Solid understanding of Windows operating system internals as they relate to update and patch application on workstations. Experience querying SCCM/Intune data via SQL or built-in reporting to build compliance dashboards. Hands-on experience packaging and deploying software and firmware updates in an enterprise Windows environment. Familiarity with application packaging tools (InstallShield, AdminStudio, or similar) is a plus. Experience with Lenovo System Update, Lenovo Thin Installer, or Lenovo Device Manager for firmware/driver management is preferred. Experience with macOS software packaging and deployment via Jamf (pkg, DMG, scripts) is a plus.
Attributes
Strong self-starter who identifies problems independently and drives them to resolution without waiting for direction. Demonstrated ability to manage and lead projects end-to-end, including planning, coordination, and delivery. Meticulous attention to detail in tracking compliance gaps and documenting findings. Excellent analytical and diagnostic skills, including the ability to trace complex deployment failures across multiple system layers on both Windows and macOS. Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate technical compliance data into concise summaries for non-technical stakeholders. Collaborative and team-oriented, with the ability to work effectively across IT functions. Comfortable engaging directly with end users to understand compliance barriers, communicate expectations, and develop pragmatic solutions that improve deployment outcomes across the firm.
Qualifications
Ability to work independently under pressure, manage competing priorities, and meet strict deadlines. Comfortable operating in an environment where update timelines are driven by security and compliance requirements. Ability to see complex, multi-phase projects through to completion.
Working Conditions
Job is performed remotely but may require occasional travel into the office; is subject to time pressures and constraints and is often dependent on input from others.
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by persons assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, qualifications and skills required of personnel so classified. The firm reserves the right to revise or modify this job description at any time.

jobs.description:
Job Title
Systems Engineer - IT Salesforce Platform

Position Overview

Shaw Industries Group, Inc. is a leader in flooring and other surface solutions designed for residential housing, commercial spaces and outdoor environments. Leveraging strengths in design, innovation and operational excellence, the company takes a people-centered, customer-focused, and growth-minded approach to meet diverse market needs. It creates differentiated customer experiences through its expansive portfolio of brands: Anderson Tuftex, COREtec, Shaw Floors, Patcraft, Philadelphia Commercial, Shaw Contract, Shaw Sports Turf, Shawgrass, Southwest Greens, Watershed Geo and more. Headquartered in Dalton, Georgia, Shaw is a wholly owned subsidiary of Berkshire Hathaway, Inc. with more than $6 billion in annual sales and 18,000 associates worldwide.

Position Overview

Our mission is to design, engineer, and continuously evolve enterprise-grade system solutions that enable Shaw to remain a market leader. As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will play a critical role in architecting and delivering scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions on the Salesforce platform (SFDC), the world's leading Customer Relationship Management system.

This role goes beyond development to include solution architecture, technical leadership, and strategic alignment with business objectives. You will partner closely with Commercial Sales, Product Owners, Enterprise Architecture, and cross-functional technology teams to design future-state capabilities across Desktop and Mobile platforms.

This position offers a dynamic opportunity to lead complex initiatives, influence platform strategy, and mentor engineering talent while driving innovation within a cloud-first ecosystem.

Responsibilities

Solution Architecture & Design
Support the end-to-end design and architecture of Salesforce-based solutions aligned to enterprise standards and long-term platform strategy.Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and high-performing technical solutions, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture and integration frameworks.Define and enforce design patterns, coding standards, and development best practices across the Salesforce ecosystem.
Technical Leadership
Serve as a technical expert and subject matter expert for Salesforce (Apex, Lightning, integrations, and platform capabilities).Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers, fostering engineering excellence and continuous learning.Provide oversight and governance for development activities, including code reviews, CI/CD practices, and release management.
Enterprise Integration & Data Strategy
Design and implement complex integrations between Salesforce and enterprise systems (e.g., middleware, MDM, data platforms).Ensure robust data architecture, including data quality, governance, and performance optimization.Collaborate with integration teams to define API strategies and event-driven architecture.
Delivery & Execution
Lead the development and implementation of complex features, enhancements, and large-scale initiatives.Allocate time across design, development, troubleshooting, and production support, with a strong emphasis on high-impact engineering work.Drive automation, DevOps, and continuous delivery improvements within the Salesforce ecosystem.
Stakeholder Engagement
Partner with business leaders and product stakeholders to shape roadmaps and prioritize initiatives.Communicate technical solutions and trade-offs effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.Act as a trusted advisor to Sales and Business teams on technology capabilities and innovation opportunities.
Quality, Security & Compliance
Ensure solutions adhere to security, compliance, and governance standards, including MFA, data protection, and regulatory requirements.Establish and maintain testing strategies, quality assurance practices, and performance benchmarks.Conduct solution reviews to ensure scalability, resiliency, and operational readiness.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).3 - 5 + years of experience in enterprise application development, with deep expertise in Salesforce platform engineering preferred.Proven experience in solution architecture, technical leadership, and large-scale system implementations.Strong experience in Salesforce technologies: Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, APIs, and platform configuration.Experience with enterprise integrations (e.g., REST/SOAP APIs, middleware platforms such as Informatica, MuleSoft, TIBCO).Strong understanding of data modeling, system integration patterns, and cloud architecture principles.Familiarity with DevOps practices, including version control, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience working with content management systems (e.g., Kentico or similar platforms)Exposure to cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or AWSExperience with monitoring, logging, or observability toolsFamiliarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment processesExperience supporting high-traffic or customer-facing websites
How We Work

Our team operates in a highly collaborative, remote-first environment. We leverage Microsoft Teams for communication and use Agile/Scrum methodologies to plan and deliver work. Our technology stack includes ASP.NET, Web APIs, and SQL Server, supporting applications hosted primarily in cloud environments.

Shaw Core Competencies

Strategic Thinking & Execution - Aligns technical solutions with long-term business strategy.

Technical Leadership - Guides teams, sets standards, and drives engineering excellence.

Stakeholder Influence - Builds strong partnerships and communicates effectively at all levels.

Innovation & Continuous Improvement - Identifies opportunities to enhance systems and processes.

Adaptability & Change Leadership - Thrives in dynamic, evolving environments.

Trust & Accountability - Demonstrates ownership, transparency, and reliability.

Work Shift
8 Hr non-rotating shift, Hrs fall to in punch day, Observed Calendar, shift starts AM

Shaw Industries is an equal opportunity employer as to all protected groups, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities.

jobs.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Are you experienced in building and managing Windows systems, with a passion for maintaining highly-available IT infrastructure and services at a massive scale? The Controls Fleet team is responsible for supporting some of Amazon's most critical infrastructure services. As part of Amazon Web Services, we power the infrastructure behind the world's premier e-commerce and cloud computing environments. To meet the growing demand for AWS services worldwide, we seek exceptionally motivated individuals driven by learning and innovation. We are looking for a passionate and motivated Windows Engineer to join our team of Systems Engineers.

By joining us, you'll become part of a world-class team in a dynamic environment with the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up. This is an opportunity to operate and engineer systems on a massive scale, gaining world-class experience in managing and supporting critical infrastructure. You'll work alongside passionate individuals dedicated to deploying and supporting essential IT infrastructure that powers AWS.

The ideal candidate will be innovative, possess excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, and thrive in a fast-paced environment. They should have a keen attention to detail and the ability to solve problems at their root. The Controls Fleet Operations team services customers globally, requiring the ability to manage multiple tasks and adapt to different challenges.

In addition, the ideal candidate should have an expert understanding of Windows tools such as Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, Hyper-V, Windows Failover Clustering, and Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (ECM) or AWS Systems Manager. Proficiency in PowerShell, or a similar scripting language, and windows automation are essential. This role demands a solid foundation in networking principles and hands-on experience with hardware troubleshooting and system building.

If you are passionate about technology, excited by the prospect of working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, and driven to solve complex problems, we would love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
• Large-Scale Windows Server Environments: Design, build, and support extensive Windows server environments.
• Enterprise Tooling: Implement and manage enterprise-scale tooling, such as Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (ECM) or AWS Systems Manager, for a large Windows fleet.
• Automation and Scripting: Develop and implement best practices for automating tasks and scripting in large server environments. Proficiency in PowerShell is essential.
• Innovation and Problem Solving: Utilize creativity and analytical skills to solve complex problems and implement innovative solutions.
• Adaptability: Quickly adjust to changing priorities and manage multiple tasks efficiently.
• Hardware Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve hardware issues, with hands-on experience in system building.
• Networking and Windows Administration: Strong understanding of networking principles and expert-level Windows administration.
• Global Deployment: Create scripts and automation tasks applicable to a global server fleet.
• On call: Participate in a 24x7 on call rotation that supports global customers
• Ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 10% of the time

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

#DCCD_AMER

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS- Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or related field or relevant work experience
- Experience working with Linux
- Knowledge of TCP/IP and networking protocols such as HTTP and DNS
- 5+ years of building scripts, tooling, and automation for large-scale computing environments experience
- Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems, or experience in technical support and experience with virtualization (Hypervisors, VMware, Xen)
- 5+ years of experience deploying, managing, and supporting large-scale Windows Server environments (500+ servers), including OS lifecycle management, patch compliance, and fleet-wide standardization across geographically distributed data center infrastructure.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS- Experience designing and developing scripts to automate operational burdens and reviewing scripting changes to ensure they meet the standards for maintainability, scalability and security

jobs.description: Our Company Oaktree is a leader among global investment managers specializing in alternative investments, with more than $220 billion in assets under management. The firm emphasizes an opportunistic, value-oriented, and risk-controlled approach to investments in credit, equity, and real estate. The firm has more than 1,400 employees and offices in more than 25 cities worldwide. We are committed to cultivating an environment that is collaborative, curious, inclusive and honors diversity of thought. Providing training and career development opportunities and emphasizing strong support for our local communities through philanthropic initiatives are essential to our culture. For additional information, please visit Oaktree’s website at http://www.oaktreecapital.com/ Responsibilities Oaktree is seeking a highly motivated and technical Endpoint Engineer to support the Information Security team at Oaktree. Endpoint Management & Engineering Own and continuously improve the modern endpoint management platform, including Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, Microsoft Entra ID, and related technologies. Manage the full Windows endpoint lifecycle, including provisioning, enrollment, configuration, compliance, application deployment, patching, OS upgrades, troubleshooting, and retirement. Lead the transition from SCCM/MECM and Group Policy–based management to modern, cloud-native endpoint management, including decommissioning legacy infrastructure. Leverage AI-assisted tools and automation to improve endpoint engineering, monitoring, troubleshooting, reporting, and operational consistency. Microsoft Intune & Modern Management Design, implement, and optimize Intune configuration profiles, compliance and security policies, application deployments, update rings, remediation scripts, and enrollment profiles. Support Microsoft Entra joined, hybrid-joined, co-managed, and cloud-native device management scenarios. Develop standardized processes for device provisioning, refresh, rebuilds, feature updates, and hardware lifecycle management. Endpoint Security & Compliance Implement and maintain endpoint security controls, including BitLocker, Microsoft Defender, Windows LAPS, Windows Hello for Business, firewall policies, attack surface reduction rules, and security baselines. Configure and monitor compliance policies to ensure devices meet organizational security requirements. Application & Operating System Management Package, deploy, test, and support applications using Intune, Win32 app deployment, Microsoft Store, PowerShell, and enterprise software distribution tools. Plan and execute Windows feature updates and OS migrations, including readiness assessments, pilot deployments, issue remediation, reporting, and production rollouts. jobs.description:
At T. Rowe Price, we identify and actively invest in opportunities to help people thrive in an evolving world. As a premier global asset management organization with more than 85 years of experience, we provide investment solutions and a broad range of equity, fixed income, and multi-asset capabilities to individuals, advisors, institutions, and retirement plan sponsors. We take an active, independent approach to investing, offering our dynamic perspective and meaningful partnership so our clients can feel more confident.

We believe doing the right thing for our clients and our associates is good business. With a career at the firm, you can expect opportunities to create real impact at work and in your community. You’ll enjoy resources to support your career path, as well as compensation, benefits, and flexibility to enrich your life. Here, you’ll find a collaborative culture that respects and values differences and colleagues who share a spirit of generosity.

Join us for the opportunity to grow and make a difference in ways that matter to you.

Role Summary

The Lead Desktop Engineer - End User Compute (EUC) serves as a senior technical leader responsible for the engineering, administration, operational health, security, and continuous improvement of the enterprise endpoint environment.

This role functions as a recognized subject matter expert across end-user computing technologies and is responsible for driving platform modernization, implementing new solutions, establishing technical standards, and ensuring the reliability and security of the organization's endpoint ecosystem.

The Lead Desktop Engineer provides technical leadership across desktop engineering initiatives, mentors junior team members, and leads the design and implementation of endpoint technologies that support business productivity, security, and operational excellence.

This position requires extensive experience managing large-scale enterprise endpoint environments and the ability to independently lead complex technical initiatives from concept through production deployment and operational support.

Responsibilities

End User Compute Platform Leadership:

Serve as a senior technical leader for enterprise endpoint platforms and workplace technologies. Lead technical design, implementation, and administration of end-user computing solutions. Establish and maintain engineering standards, operational procedures, and platform best practices. Act as a primary escalation point for complex endpoint and platform issues. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to Desktop Engineers and Senior Desktop Engineers.

Endpoint Engineering & Administration

Engineer, administer, and maintain enterprise endpoint management platforms. Ensure operational health, stability, and performance across the endpoint fleet. Develop device configuration standards and security baselines. Manage operating system lifecycle activities including deployments, upgrades, and patch management. Support Windows, macOS, virtual desktop, and cloud-based endpoint platforms as required.

Modern Workplace Solutions

Lead the implementation of new technologies that improve user experience, security, automation, and operational efficiency. Evaluate emerging technologies and provide technical recommendations. Design and implement modern endpoint management capabilities, including Modern Device Management (MDM), zero-touch provisioning, endpoint security controls, virtual desktop technologies, Cloud PC solutions, and Digital Employee Experience platforms. Develop technical designs, implementation plans, testing strategies, and deployment methodologies.

Security & Compliance

Partner with Information Security teams to strengthen endpoint security posture. Implement and maintain endpoint security controls and compliance requirements, including appropriate use of Microsoft Defender Antivirus and Windows Defender Application Control (WDAC). Support vulnerability management, remediation, and risk-reduction initiatives. Assist with incident response activities involving endpoint technologies. Ensure endpoint platforms align with corporate security policies and regulatory requirements.

Automation & Process Improvement

Develop automation solutions to improve operational efficiency and platform scalability. Leverage scripting and automation technologies to reduce manual effort. Continuously identify opportunities for operational improvement. Create and maintain technical documentation, procedures, and knowledge articles.

Project Leadership

Lead endpoint-focused projects and engineering initiatives. Coordinate technical activities across infrastructure, security, network, and support teams. Manage technical deliverables, implementation schedules, and platform readiness activities. Ensure successful transition of new solutions into ongoing operations.

Qualifications

Required:

7+ years of experience supporting and engineering enterprise endpoint environments. 5+ years of experience administering large-scale enterprise desktop management platforms. Advanced experience supporting Windows endpoint environments. Experience with modern endpoint management technologies such as Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM), Microsoft Entra ID, and Jamf Pro. Familiarity with endpoint security capabilities such as Microsoft Defender Antivirus and Windows Defender Application Control (WDAC). Strong experience with PowerShell and automation. Experience implementing endpoint security technologies and controls. Experience leading enterprise technology deployments and platform modernization efforts. Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and root-cause analysis skills. Excellent communication and technical leadership abilities.

Preferred

Experience supporting environments with 5,000+ endpoints. Experience with Windows 365, Azure Virtual Desktop, Citrix Experience with Microsoft Defender Antivirus, Windows Defender Application Control (WDAC), CrowdStrike, Tanium, Nexthink, or similar enterprise management and security solutions. Experience with endpoint vulnerability management programs. Experience in financial services or other highly regulated environments. Relevant Microsoft, VMware, Citrix, Jamf, or security certifications.

Leadership Expectations

Be recognized as a technical subject matter expert within End User Compute. Lead through technical expertise and influence. Independently drive complex engineering initiatives. Mentor and develop junior team members. Make sound technical decisions balancing user experience, reliability, security, and operational efficiency. Promote automation, standardization, and continuous improvement. Collaborate effectively across technology teams and business stakeholders.

FINRA Requirements

FINRA licenses are not required and will not be supported for this role.

Work Flexibility

This role is eligible for hybrid work, with up to three days per week from home.

Base Salary Ranges

Please review the job posting for the location of this specific opportunity.

$122,000.00 - $209,000.00 for the location of: Maryland, Colorado, Washington and remote workers

Placement within the range provided above is based on the individual’s relevant experience and skills for the role. Base salary is only one component of our total compensation package. Employees may be eligible for a discretionary bonus, which is determined upon company and individual performance.

At T. Rowe Price, our associates are our greatest asset. We thrive because our company culture is built on inclusion and because we sustain a work environment where associates can bring their best selves to work every day. The backgrounds, talents, and experiences of our global associates allow us to embrace new ideas and perspectives that move our business priorities forward and enable us to deliver strong client outcomes. Here, you can expect equal opportunity and fair and consistent treatment for all.

Benefits

We value your goals and needs, at work and in life. As an associate, you’ll be supported with resources, benefits, and work-life balance so you can thrive in ways that matter to you.

Competitive compensation Annual bonus eligibility A generous retirement plan Hybrid work schedule Health and wellness benefits, including online therapy Paid time off for vacation, illness, medical appointments, and volunteering days Family care resources, including fertility and adoption benefits

jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced and proactive Level 3 Mac Desktop Engineer to join our Workplace Technology team. This role is ideal for a solution-driven professional who not only supports Mac users at an advanced level but also architects and improves endpoint management systems with a focus on scalability, automation, and security. You will serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for macOS, Jamf Pro, and Microsoft 365 within the enterprise environment, and play a critical role in enhancing the end-user experience through strategic IT initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:

- Strategic Endpoint Management: Lead the development and lifecycle management of Mac endpoints using Jamf Pro, with a focus on automation, standardization, and security compliance.
- Jamf Pro Ownership: Own the architecture, configuration, and enhancement of our Jamf Pro instance. Develop custom policies, profiles, and packages to support business needs.
- Application Packaging & Deployment: Package and maintain applications for deployment via Jamf. Ensure software is up to date, tested, and compliant with organizational standards and licensing requirements.
- Automation & Scripting: Design and implement automation using Bash, Python, or AppleScript to streamline provisioning, patching, and incident resolution workflows.
- Advanced Troubleshooting & Escalation: Act as the final escalation point for complex Mac-related incidents and systemic issues. Perform root cause analysis and long-term resolution planning.
- Security & Compliance: Collaborate with InfoSec to enforce macOS security baselines (e.g., CIS benchmarks) and manage encrypted deployments, device hardening, and compliance reporting via Jamf and other tools.
- Cross-Platform Integration: Partner with Windows and SaaS teams to ensure seamless integration across platforms and identity systems (e.g., CyberArk, Azure AD, Active Directory).
- Microsoft 365 & SaaS Administration: Provide advanced support and policy management within M365 and other critical cloud SaaS platforms as they relate to macOS endpoints.
- Lifecycle & Asset Management: Implement and maintain lifecycle processes for Apple devices from procurement through decommission, integrating asset tracking and compliance monitoring.
- Documentation & Enablement: Create and maintain thorough documentation, workflows, and training resources for IT staff and end-users. Provide mentoring and technical guidance to junior team members.
- Project Leadership: Lead or contribute to IT projects involving system upgrades, new technology rollouts, and endpoint security initiatives.

Qualifications:

- 5+ years of hands-on experience supporting and managing macOS in a medium-to-large enterprise setting.
- Expert-level proficiency with Jamf Pro administration, including advanced policy creation, smart groups, patch management, and extension attributes.
- Strong understanding of macOS system internals, security frameworks, and enterprise deployment models.
- Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Bash, Python) and experience automating repetitive IT tasks.
- Familiarity with MDM/APNs, Apple Business Manager, DEP, and VPP.
- In-depth knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration and integration in cross-platform environments.
- Strong analytical, communication, and customer service skills.
- Certifications such as Jamf 300+, Apple Certified Support Professional (ACSP), or Certified IT Professional (CompTIA, ITIL) are a strong plus.

Preferred Skills:

- Experience integrating Jamf Pro with identity providers (e.g., CyberArk, Azure AD).
- Familiarity with Zero-Touch deployment workflows.
- Experience with security tools and policies for endpoint protection (e.g., FileVault, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne).
- Working knowledge of Windows 10/11, particularly in mixed OS environments, to support collaboration with Windows fleet management and cross-platform issues.
- Strong understanding of Microsoft 365 administration, including policy management, endpoint compliance, and integration with macOS.

Description

Principal Cloud Platform Engineer

The Center for Elders’ Independence is a PACE (Program of All-Inclusive Care for the elderly) organization (PO) that uses an interdisciplinary team approach for care planning and implementing purposeful high quality, affordable, and integrated health care services to the elderly. Our elderly meet PACE requirements as prescribed by CMS and are referred to as participants. Our PO includes Adult Day Health Centers and primary care clinics, promoting participant autonomy, quality of life and the ability for individuals to live in their communities

THE POS I TION : We are seeking a Principal Cloud Platform Engineer to design, deploy, operate, and continuously improve CEI’s Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Fabric platform. This hands-on role provides the shared cloud foundation for enterprise integrations, APIs, workflow automation, data pipelines, internal applications, analytics, and AI solutions. The engineer will establish consistent development, QA, and production environments; automate deployments; implement security and operational standards; and ensure that cloud services are observable, reliable, scalable, and supportable in production.

The annual pay range for the Principal Cloud Platform Engineer position at Center for Elders’ Independence is $ 113,713 to $ 173,981 . Placement within the range is determined based on job-related factors such as relevant experience, skills, abilities, internal equity, and market data, consistent with CEI’s annual compensation review and established compensation practices.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Build, configure, and maintain Azure cloud-native services, including Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Event Hubs or Service Bus, API Management, Container Apps, Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and related services. Support Microsoft Fabric and OneLake connectivity, deployment, integration, monitoring, and production operations in partnership with data and analytics teams. Establish and maintain standardized development, QA, and production environments with appropriate separation, access controls, configuration management, and release processes. Provision and manage cloud resources through repeatable Infrastructure as Code using Bicep, ARM templates, Terraform, or comparable tools. Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines for cloud applications, integrations, automation, and data services using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or comparable platforms. Implement centralized logging, monitoring, alerting, service-health checks, dashboards, and operational telemetry for production services. Troubleshoot cloud incidents, coordinate recovery, perform root-cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive actions. Manage application identities, role-based access, secrets, certificates, service accounts, and secure connectivity in coordination with CEI Security and Infrastructure teams. Define and enforce standards for resource naming, tagging, configuration, deployment, rollback, backup, recovery, and production readiness. Review vendor-delivered cloud components for alignment with CEI architecture, security, documentation, support, and operational requirements. Monitor platform performance, capacity, availability, cloud utilization, and cost; recommend practical improvements to reliability and efficiency. Create reusable platform components, technical documentation, operational runbooks, and support procedures that enable application, integration, data, automation, and AI teams. Support the transition of prototypes and project deliverables into governed, secure, and fully supported production services. Work collaboratively with Enterprise Applications, Data Engineering, Security, Infrastructure, project teams, implementation partners, and vendors.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Strong hands-on knowledge of Azure serverless computing, messaging, APIs, containers, identity, secrets management, monitoring, and logging. Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automated CI/CD pipelines. Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, RBAC, Key Vault, networking, and secure application connectivity. Strong scripting and automation skills using PowerShell, Python, Azure CLI, or similar tools. Experience with production incident response, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and operational documentation. Ability to translate architecture, security, and operational requirements into repeatable platform standards and implementation patterns. Strong analytical, organizational, documentation, and communication skills. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science , Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and professional experience. Five or more years of experience in cloud engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, site reliability engineering, or a closely related technical role. Demonstrated experience building and supporting production services in Microsoft Azure. Experience supporting controlled development, QA, and production environments in an enterprise setting. Experience working across application , data, security, infrastructure, and vendor teams.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

Experience with Microsoft Fabric, OneLake , Fabric deployment pipelines, or Fabric administration. Experience supporting enterprise integration platforms, event-driven architectures, APIs, or workflow automation. Experience working with healthcare, PII, PHI, HIPAA-regulated data, or other regulated environments. Microsoft Azure, DevOps, security, or related technical certifications.

The above job description is intended to communicate the general function of the mentioned position and by no means shall be considered an exhaustive or complete outline of the specific tasks and functions that will be required. CEI reserves the right to change job descriptions, site assignments, and or work hours as required by the needs of the program. All employees are expected to perform their duties within their ability as required by the job and/or as requested by management.

jobs.description:
About Zscaler

Zscaler accelerates digital transformation to ensure our customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. As an AI-forward enterprise , we are constantly pushing the envelope, leveraging the world’s largest security data lake to power our cloud-native Zero Trust Exchange platform. This innovation protects our customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location.

Here, impact in your role matters more than title and trust is built on results. We say, impact over activity. We seek innovators who actively use AI to amplify their impact and who thrive in an environment where we leverage intelligent systems to stay ahead of evolving threats. We believe in transparency and value constructive, honest debate —we’re focused on getting to the best ideas, faster. We build high-performing teams that can make an impact quickly and with high quality. To do this, we are building a culture of execution centered on customer obsession , collaboration, ownership, and accountability.

We value high-impact, high-accountability with a sense of urgency where you’re enabled to do your best work and embrace your potential. If you’re driven by purpose, thrive on solving complex challenges, and want to be part of the team that’s helping to secure the AI age, we invite you to bring your talents to Zscaler and help shape the future of cybersecurity.

Role

As an Information System Engineer in our IT Digital Employee department (reporting to the Manager, End User Engineering), you will design, implement, and support Zscaler’s global end-user computing (EUC) environment across Windows, macOS, BYOD, and Mobile platforms. jobs.description:
Prevent problems. Improve environments. Make IT easier to support.

ET&T is looking for an experienced "Technical Alignment Engineer" who believes the best support ticket is the one that never needs to be opened.

This is not a traditional help desk role. Your primary responsibility will be to proactively evaluate, document, standardize, and improve our clients’ technology environments.

You will conduct regular remote and on-site reviews, compare client environments against ET&T’s defined technical and cybersecurity standards, and remediate issues within an established scope. When a finding requires greater planning, investment, or architectural change, you will clearly document the need and help transition it into a properly scoped project.

The right person combines broad technical knowledge with curiosity, organization, sound judgment, and exceptional documentation habits.

What You’ll Do

Audit client environments against ET&T’s technical, operational, and cybersecurity standards.
Remediate identified gaps using approved standards and procedures.
Determine whether findings should be resolved immediately, scheduled as controlled changes, discussed with the client, or scoped as projects.
Maintain accurate client documentation, including infrastructure, applications, credentials, assets, network diagrams, procedures, and client-specific support information.
Conduct regular client site visits to complete physical assessments, remediation, and documentation.
Build trusted client relationships through clear communication and professional follow-through.
Identify risks, recurring problems, aging infrastructure, and opportunities for long-term improvement.
Provide clear technical handoffs to service leadership, project teams, and account management.
Serve as a Level 2 escalation resource as needed.
Help improve ET&T’s technical standards and internal processes based on what you encounter in the field.

Our standards cover a broad range of areas, including servers, workstations, networking, firewalls, backups, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, identity, security tools, and documentation.

You’ll Be Successful Here If You

Prefer preventing recurring problems over repeatedly fixing symptoms.
Can methodically assess an unfamiliar technology environment.
Treat documentation as part of completing the technical work.
Follow standards while recognizing when an exception or escalation is necessary.
Can balance technical quality, client impact, risk, effort, and urgency.
Communicate clearly with both technical and nontechnical people.
Take ownership of findings through remediation, escalation, or documented handoff.
Are comfortable working independently while remaining accountable to a team.

jobs.description:
Job Description

The AI and Digital Workplace Engineer is the senior technical owner of the talent agency's AI-enabled productivity and collaboration experience - and the deep hands-on engineer behind the identity, endpoint, and Microsoft 365 platform that experience runs on. The role selects, deploys, integrates, and continuously improves the AI tools and capabilities embedded in the digital workplace, while engineering and operating the underlying Entra ID, endpoint, and M365 services to an operational-excellence standard. It is the senior technical voice on AI tooling for the IT organization and the broader business, and the engineering lead for IT's own use of AI to automate, augment, and improve service delivery.

Read the role as two layers. The foundation is senior digital workplace engineering: identity (Entra ID, conditional access, SSO/SAML/OIDC, hybrid identity, PIM, B2B), endpoint management (Intune and Jamf), M365 service engineering (Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive), and the ITIL/ITSM discipline that keeps those services reliable. The differentiating scope is AI: the engineer is accountable for ensuring AI tools are well-chosen, well-integrated, well-governed, and well-adopted. A credible candidate is strong on the foundation and demonstrably advanced on the AI scope.

This role is the operational expression of an AI-first IT culture built on a reliable digital workplace. It partners with the cybersecurity governance function on AI risk and policy, with the workforce AI adoption and enablement program on AI literacy and adoption, and with end users across the business on AI experience and capability.

We are a company committed to creating diverse and inclusive environments where people can bring their full, authentic selves to work every day. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer that believes everyone matters. Qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment regardless of their race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, marital status, national origin, ancestry, genetic factors, age, disability, protected veteran status, military or uniformed service member status, or any other status or characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please send a request to ~~~ learn more about how we collect, keep, and process your private information, please review Insight Global's Workforce Privacy Policy: ~~~/.

Skills and Requirements

7+ years of engineering experience in digital workplace, productivity platforms, or related domains, including deep hands-on experience across Microsoft 365, identity, and endpoints.

Deep Microsoft 365 platform engineering: Exchange Online (mail flow, permissions, distribution lists, shared mailboxes); Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive service engineering and troubleshooting; Power Platform.

Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) engineering: conditional access, group management and identity governance, SSO / SAML / OIDC integrations, hybrid identity and Entra Connect, identity lifecycle automation (Joiner / Mover / Leaver), PIM, and B2B / guest access governance.

Endpoint management across Windows (Intune) and macOS (Jamf or equivalent MDM): policy, compliance, provisioning, and performance.

Proven ability to troubleshoot across the full stack - identity, devices, and applications.

2+ years of hands-on experience deploying, integrating, or building on top of enterprise AI capabilities (Microsoft 365 Copilot, conversational AI assistants, AI APIs, or equivalent).

Automation against enterprise APIs (Microsoft Graph, Power Automate, integration platforms) and scripting experience (PowerShell, Python, or similar).

Hands-on ITIL practice across incident, problem, change, and continual service improvement (ITIL certified or equivalent).

jobs.description:
PENN Entertainment, Inc. is North America's leading provider of integrated entertainment, sports content, and casino gaming experiences. From casinos and racetracks to online gaming, sports betting and entertainment content, we deliver the experiences people want, how and where they want them.

We're always on the lookout for those who are passionate about creating and delivering cutting-edge online gaming and sports media products. Whether it's through Hollywood Casino, theScore Bet Sportsbook, or theScore media app, we're excited to push the boundaries of what's possible. These state-of-the-art platforms are powered by proprietary in-house technology, a key component of PENN's omnichannel gaming and entertainment strategy.

When you join PENN Entertainment's digital team, you'll not only work on these cutting-edge platforms through theScore and PENN Interactive, but you'll also be part of a company that truly cares about your career growth. We're committed to supporting you as you expand your skills and explore new opportunities.

With locations throughout North America, you can build a future at PENN Entertainment wherever you are. If you want to challenge conventions in gaming, media and entertainment, we want to talk to you.

About the Team
The Client Platform team's job is to make product teams fast. We own the shared component libraries and design system, the build and release tooling every engineer touches daily, and the performance, accessibility, and observability standards that hold across our client surfaces. Much of the work is internal tooling that keeps a large monorepo pleasant to work in. We partner closely with product teams to make the right thing the easy thing.

The team also builds our server-driven UI service, a TypeScript GraphQL subgraph that lets product teams change what the iOS, Android, and web clients render without shipping an app release. The role spans both the monorepo and that service, so it is a genuine mix of front-end and backend GraphQL work.

About the Work

Design and evolve GraphQL schemas in a federated graph, including the server-driven UI contracts our mobile and web clients render.

Treat those schemas as a versioned contract shared with released mobile apps: classify breaking changes, coordinate migrations with the iOS, Android, and web leads, and keep generated client models in sync.
Develop, scale, and optimize the GraphQL APIs, RPC endpoints, and SQL queries behind our web surfaces.

Build front-end applications and shared libraries with React and TypeScript.

Build web applications that are fast and accessible to everyone.

Partner with product and design to architect and ship customer-facing features.
Use observability tooling to diagnose issues and improve the experience for guests.

Set up and refine monitoring and alerting in DataDog for the systems you own.

Improve code quality by finding technical debt, proposing fixes, and holding the standard for the whole team.
Find bottlenecks and areas of risk in production, and drive the changes that make the platform scale.
Learn from and mentor teammates through code review, pairing, and writing things down.
Take part in the design, architecture, and delivery of new features in a collaborative agile team.
Write thorough tests for every feature and bug fix. Testing is a first-class discipline on this team.
Work with QA to strengthen automated testing pipelines and CI/CD workflows.
Use Claude Code in daily development to move faster without lowering the bar.
Other duties as required.

About You

At least 5 years of experience in software engineering.
Strong JavaScript, TypeScript, and React, plus real instincts for UX.
2+ years designing and evolving GraphQL schemas for product surfaces used by multiple clients (iOS, Android, web). This sits at the center of the server-driven UI work, so it matters more here than in a typical front-end role.
Fluency with HTML, CSS, and the browser environment: DOM, events, platform APIs.
A solid foundation in computer science, with strong competencies in data structures, distributed systems, algorithms, and software design.
A grasp of production systems at scale, including finding weak points through load testing and tracing.
Experience investigating and fixing production performance regressions, including CPU hotspots and latency in high-throughput services.
Experience on an on-call rotation for a production service, and owning release cycles end to end.
You care about clean architecture and about code you will not mind reading a year from now.
Clear writing. You have authored tech specs, runbooks, and cross-team design docs that stood up to scrutiny.
Experience with API development in Node or Bun, or in another server framework (Phoenix, Ruby on Rails, FastAPI, Laravel).
Experience building and integrating multi-client or white-label platforms, including geo-based routing and per-brand configuration.
Experience with Kubernetes and comfort operating services in containers.
Comfortable working in the terminal, with Git and GitHub or similar, and in an editor of your choice.
Experience with testing frameworks: Jest or Vitest, and ExUnit, RSpec, or pytest.
Nice to have: Apollo Federation at scale, GraphQL APIs with Absinthe, Mobile Development for iOS or Android using Swift or Kotlin, hexagonal architecture, domain-driven design, relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL), background job processing (Oban, Exq, Sidekiq, Celery), asynchronous event infrastructure (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS/SNS, Pub/Sub), open source contributions, startup experience, and a passion for sports or esports.

What We Offer

Competitive compensation package
Fun, relaxed work environment
Education and conference reimbursements.
Opportunities for career progression and mentoring others

IRC300453 – IT Infrastructure Engineer (Client: Medically Home)
Position Type: Contract (4-6 months)

Location: Denver, CO (100% Onsite)

Project Description:

We are seeking an experienced Network Engineer to spearhead the modernization and reinstallation of physical network infrastructure across various office locations. This role is critical for transitioning legacy environments to a high-performance, standardized architecture.

Infrastructure Assessment & Research: Audit legacy Fortinet configurations; identify critical functionalities; research existing hardware/software dependencies; and troubleshoot unknown Wi‑Fi hardware.
Deployment: Replicate firewall and switching functionality within a new Ubiquiti environment; configure and deploy new switching hardware (12 or 14-port units); and reconfigure physical network layouts.

Required Skillset:

Advanced expertise in Fortinet (FortiGate) and Ubiquiti platforms.
Proficiency in Layer 2 and Layer 3 switching and configuration.
Proven ability to map and translate firewall rules between different vendors.
Expert-level Wi‑Fi diagnostic skills and strong analytical skills for complex legacy systems.

jobs.description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

IT Support & Infrastructure Engineer

About the Role

We are looking for a highly experienced IT Infrastructure & Support Engineer to join the Development Tools IT Team at Sony Interactive Entertainment.

This is a senior hands-on internal IT role supporting approximately 120 users across Bristol and Dublin, most of whom are developers and highly technical staff. You will work as part of a small IT team responsible for local support, infrastructure operations, security remediation, monitoring and project delivery.

The role is ideal for an experienced senior support engineer, infrastructure support engineer, systems engineer or 3rd line engineer who enjoys broad technical ownership and hands-on problem solving.

You will act as a key senior technical person within the team. You will take ownership of complex support issues, support and administer local infrastructure, help improve patching and vulnerability remediation, contribute to infrastructure projects, and provide guidance to less senior team members where appropriate.

This is not a narrowly defined project-only role. Because we are a small team, everyone gets involved where needed. While there is significant exposure to infrastructure and project work, you should also be comfortable helping with user-facing support and advanced desktop issues.

What You’ll Be Doing

- Acting as a senior technical escalation point within the local IT team.

- Taking ownership of complex 2nd and 3rd line support tickets.

- Troubleshooting advanced Windows desktop, Linux and MacOS endpoint, server and infrastructure issues.

- Supporting Windows 11 laptops, desktops and developer workstations.

- Providing support for Linux and MacOS endpoints.

- Supporting Windows Server environments, including Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, file services and Remote Desktop Services.

- Assisting with local domain administration and Group Policy improvements.

- Supporting VMware administration, including managing and building virtual machines and managing ESXi hosts.

- Supporting migration to Proxmox hypervisor

- Troubleshooting issues involving DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, switching, VPNs and firewalls.

- Supporting a Juniper switching and Palo Alto firewall environment.

- Working with global SIE teams where services are centrally managed.

- Supporting vulnerability remediation and patching using tools such as KACE, Qualys and Domo.

- Investigating patch failures and working with users to resolve remediation issues.

- Supporting endpoint security processes involving tools such as CrowdStrike.

- Monitoring systems and alerts using Zabbix.

- Helping shape and improve IT alerting processes.

- Supporting backup and recovery processes using Commvault.

- Creating and maintaining documentation, troubleshooting guides and runbooks in Confluence.

- Supporting infrastructure improvement projects.

- Working alongside wider internal IT functions

- Helping guide and support the Desktop Support Engineer where appropriate.

- Helping reduce IT friction for a highly technical developer user base.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone with strong technical support and infrastructure experience, excellent troubleshooting ability, and the confidence to act as a senior technical person within a small IT team.

You should have:

- Proven experience in a senior 2nd line, 3rd line, infrastructure support, systems support or similar role.

- Experience collaborating with wider support and technical teams

- Excellent Windows11 support and troubleshooting skills.

- Hands-on Windows Server support and administration experience.

- Experience with Active Directory and Group Policy.

- Good understanding of DNS, DHCP, file services and permissions.

- Good networking fundamentals, including subnets, VLANs, switching, routing, VPNs and firewalls.

- Hands-on VMware administration experience.

- Confidence managing and building virtual machines.

- Understanding of patch management and vulnerability remediation.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Confidence investigating issues thoroughly rather than simply escalating them.

- Experience taking ownership of complex technical issues.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Good documentation habits.

- Ability to prioritise work in a busy technical environment.

- Willingness to work across support levels in a small team.

- Confidence supporting highly technical users.

- A genuine interest in improving systems, processes and infrastructure maturity.

Desirable Skills

Any of the following would be useful but are not essential:

- Linux support or administration experience.

- macOS support experience.

- Juniper switching experience.

- Palo Alto firewall exposure.

- Commvault backup experience.

- Zabbix monitoring experience.

- Tanium experience.

- Perforce experience.

- KACE patching experience.

- Qualys vulnerability management experience.

- Domo reporting experience.

- CrowdStrike experience.

- PowerShell scripting.

- General scripting or automation experience.

- Proxmox experience.

- ESXi host build or management experience.

- ITIL knowledge.

- Experience supporting developers or technical engineering users.

- Experience working in a larger enterprise environment with central or global IT teams.

- Experience mentoring or supporting junior engineers.

About You

You will be someone who:

- Enjoys troubleshooting and technical problem solving.

- Is calm, methodical and analytical.

- Communicates clearly with technical and non-technical users.

- Is comfortable supporting highly technical developers.

- Takes ownership of issues and follows them through.

- Documents fixes and shares knowledge.

- Is organised and able to manage competing priorities.

- Wants to own and improve the environment around them.

- Is happy working in a small team where everyone helps where needed.

- Wants to improve systems and processes, not just close tickets.

- Can work pragmatically in an environment where users have complex tools and local admin rights.

- Is comfortable acting as a senior technical presence within the team.

Working Pattern and Out-of-Hours

Expected work pattern, 3 days per week in the Bristol office. 2 day flexible working from home depending on business requirements.

There is no formal on-call rota for this role.

Occasional evening or weekend maintenance may be required for planned work such as infrastructure changes, patching or upgrades. Time off in lieu is provided for approved out-of-hours work.

Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks.

Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights.

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Sony is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All persons will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, trade union membership or membership in any other legally protected category.

We strive to create an inclusive environment, empower employees and embrace diversity. We encourage everyone to respond.

Sony Interactive Entertainment is a Fair Chance employer and qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for employment.

jobs.description:
Description

Position Summary

The Endpoint Management Engineer is responsible for the design, deployment, security, and ongoing operation of the endpoint management platforms Encore Technologies uses to manage client device estates. This is a platform-agnostic role: the engineer works across Microsoft Intune and Configuration Manager, NinjaOne, HCL BigFix, and other unified endpoint management (UEM) and remote monitoring and management (RMM) toolsets, supporting Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, and Linux endpoints across multiple client tenants.

The role owns the full endpoint lifecycle zero-touch provisioning, application packaging and delivery, patch and vulnerability remediation, security baseline enforcement, telemetry and reporting, and secure device retirement. The engineer is expected to work automation-first, using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, and native platform scripting to eliminate manual effort, and to lead modernization efforts such as co-management, Configuration Manager to Intune migration, and RMM platform consolidation during client transitions.

This position serves as the senior technical escalation point for endpoint issues raised by the Service Desk, ITOCC, and On-Site Support teams, and partners with Security Operations, client stakeholders, and Encore delivery leadership to translate business and compliance requirements into scalable, well-documented endpoint standards.

Responsibilities:

· Platform Administration – Design, deploy, configure, and maintain endpoint management platforms including Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Configuration Manager (MECM), NinjaOne, and HCL BigFix across single-tenant and multi-tenant client environments.

· Zero-Touch Provisioning – Build and maintain modern provisioning workflows using Windows Autopilot, Apple Business Manager and Automated Device Enrollment, and Android Enterprise, reducing image-based build effort and shortening device delivery timelines.

· Application Packaging and Delivery – Package, test, publish, and version control enterprise applications (Win32, MSIX, MSI, Winget, Homebrew, PKG) with defined detection rules, dependencies, supersedence, and rollback paths.

· Patch and Vulnerability Remediation – Own operating system and third-party patch cycles across all managed platforms, coordinate maintenance windows using ring-based deployment, and remediate findings surfaced by vulnerability management tooling within contracted SLAs.

· Security Baseline Enforcement – Implement and maintain ‘hardening’ baselines and compliance policies (CIS Benchmarks, Microsoft Security Baselines, NIST) including disk encryption, attack surface reduction, application control, local administrator management, endpoint detection and agent health.

· Identity and Access Integration – Configure device compliance, Conditional Access policies, certificate and Wi-Fi/VPN profile delivery in partnership with the identity team, ensuring endpoint posture is a trusted signal in access decisions.

· Automation and Scripting – Develop and maintain PowerShell, Bash, Microsoft Graph API automations, Intune remediation scripts, tool specific scripting (Ex. BigFix custom scripting) to automate deployments, configuration drift correction, and reporting.

· Endpoint Health and Digital Employee Experience – Monitor agent health, policy compliance, and device performance telemetry; use DEX data to proactively identify and resolve endpoint issues before they generate tickets.

· Platform Migration and Modernization – Lead endpoint workstreams during client transitions and modernization projects, including co-management enablement, Configuration Manager to Intune workload migration, tenant-to-tenant moves, and RMM platform consolidation.

· Multi-Tenant Governance – Configure and maintain role-based access control, scope tags, organizational units, policy naming standards, and change control across client tenants to protect data separation and enforce least privilege.

· Technical Escalation – Serve as tier-3 escalation for endpoint incidents and problems raised by the Service Desk, ITOCC, and field teams; perform root cause analysis and drive permanent corrective action.

· ITSM and Change Management – Integrate endpoint platforms with ITSM tooling for asset, incident, and request automation, and submit endpoint changes through the established change management process with tested back-out plans.

· Reporting and Client Reviews – Produce compliance, patch, and lifecycle reporting for internal leadership and client business reviews, translating platform telemetry into clear risk and health narratives.

· Documentation and Enablement – Maintain run books, standard operating procedures, and configuration-as-documented records for every managed platform, and transfer knowledge to Service Desk and field teams through training and knowledge base content.

· Technology Evaluation – Track vendor roadmaps and emerging endpoint capabilities, evaluate new tooling against Encore service standards, and recommend improvements that reduce cost, risk, or manual effort.

Qualifications:

· Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

· Minimum of 5 years of hands-on endpoint management experience in enterprise or managed services environments.

· Demonstrated production experience with at least two enterprise endpoint management platforms, such as Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Configuration Manager, NinjaOne, HCL BigFix, Tanium, Jamf, or Workspace ONE.

· Working knowledge of modern Windows management, including Autopilot, co-management, Windows Update for Business, and Windows Update rings.

· Experience managing non-Windows endpoints, including macOS and iOS/Android mobile device and application management.

· Strong scripting and automation skills in PowerShell, with working knowledge of Microsoft Graph API; Bash or Python experience is a plus.

· Solid understanding of Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Group Policy, certificate services, and Conditional Access.

· Practical experience with endpoint security tooling and hardening standards, including Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, disk encryption, privilege management, and CIS or NIST baselines.

· Application packaging and software distribution experience across multiple formats and platforms.

· Familiarity with ITSM practices and platforms, including incident, problem, and change management workflows.

· Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to isolate complex issues across identity, network, application, and device layers.

· Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work across cross-functional teams and explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

· Preferred certifications: Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102), Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate, CompTIA Security+, Apple Certified Support Professional, ITIL 4 Foundation, or platform-specific NinjaOne or BigFix certifications.

· Prior experience in a managed service provider or multi-client environment is strongly preferred.

Physical Requirements:

· Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on the computer.

· Occasional lifting, pushing, and pulling up to 15 lbs.

· Hybrid position: in-office and remote workdays.

· Occasional travel to client sites within the greater Cincinnati and Northern Kentucky region.

· Participation in a scheduled on-call rotation and periodic after-hours maintenance windows.
